tei:div.tei:p: ci::skeskejigudh+ri /me+eshā shāchihā sdumuṭāhācu0 'jicuX5nga0ji0jiske jing 5055jicu 7 mici glujimi༈༷750ta glu༈
༄7/ /rgya gzhung skor gyi tshad ma phyogs bsgrigs//ṭ+wāṃ ’/

kospre dhe nga ji — wadzi/ /// smo7wadzerdo )ni she— — / 7 ram̐/rjornyi noglo tswangakwaphro k+ṣ-i dzesgru ne r+yā zhe ri spre rdzo— rke cho/ jardza / phre (1——— ṣ+ṭha ri tho tsho sgo 7ram̐ 9 sne lnge ci zu ‘ 4 ge blo— r+ṣa ne ge byu muskadū—— getre
byergya gzhung skowa / wawa wapa phyo /wa/ bsgrigs/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/de yang ma 'dris pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po gang gis zhabs kyisabacags shing byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mchog rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang /bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir lo paṇa mkhas grub dag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi sngon nas dar zhing rgyas par byas/de nas bzung ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dag gis sbyang brtson byas pa'i 'bras rtags su/bka' bstan gyi rig gzhung dag la 'grel ba dang 'grel bshad kyi gsung rab brgya phrag grangs med pa mdzad de rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnamasal bgo skal du bzhag na yang /de dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung rab rnams las sngar rgya che'i rig gzhung la thos bsam gyi sgo nas slob gnyer byed pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul ma thub pa 'ga' zhig da lan sprul 'jam dbyangs blo gros mchog gis ma dngul yongs rdzogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas rgya che'i nang bstan gyi rig gzhung la thos bsam byed pa po rnams kyi slob gnyer byed pa'i cha rkyen du dmigs nas bka' bstan gyi rig gzhung dang dpe rnying khag mu mthud du mdo sngags slob gling rig gzhung rtsom sgrig tshogs pa 〉nasapar sgrun zhusate/shes rab kyi mkhyen rgya yangs pa rnams kyi spyan lam du spel ba lags na/thengs 'dir glegs bam dkon rigasakyi gras su gyur pa dpal chos kyi grags pasamadzad pa'i tshad ma sde bdun zhes bya ba 'di nyid par sgrun byas pas gzhung chen la slob gnyer byed pa po rnams kyi spyi nor du 'gyur ba'i re smon dang bcas/ rnaṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ trī sbya/ ///sa slob gling ngesadon rig pa'i dga' tshal gyinapa bstan rig gartsa rtsom sgrig tshogasapa nasaphyi lo 2—8zla

dkar chag rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel balhags so sa kyi grags pa/ 1'gi brjod/ 11 rang do na rjes su di pag pa'i le'u/ 1lha tshad ma grub pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ ci 318 mngen sum gye le'u/ 56 gzhan ni na gyi tshig spre'ur byas pa'i le'u 104mjuka byang / 130tshad ma rnam par ngernga pa bzhugs so/ chosakyi grags pa 132'go brjod 1321 mngon sum gtan la dbab pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 132lha rang don gyi rjepha su dpag pa rnam par nges pa'i le'u 1633 gzhan gyi don gyi rjes su dpag pa'i le'u 206mjug byang / 293rigs pa'i thigs pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ chosakyi grags pa/ 294'go brjod/ 2941 mdzon sum gyi le'u/ 294lha bdag gi don rje su dpag pa'i le'u 2958 gzhan gyi don rje su dpag pa'i le'u/ 298mjug byang 309

gtan chigs kyi thigs pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ chos kyi grags pa/310'go brjod/ 310gzhung don/ 310mjug byang / 347'brel pa brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa(rtsa ba) chos kyi grags pa/348gzhung don/ 348mjug byang 350'asbol pa brtag pa'i 'grel pa/ chos kyi grags pa 351'go brjod/ 351gzhung don/ 351mjug byang 363rgyud gzhan grub pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa chos kyi grags pa/364'go brjod/ 364gzhung don/ 364mjug byang ci 372rtsad pa'i rigs pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ chos kyi kras/sa pa/373'go brjod 373gzhung don 373mjug byang / 437

rgyas sda'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel bzhugag so/chos kyi grags pa/'go brjod/rgya gar skod du/ spru rmā rte sprur ti tā kā ri tā/ bod skad du/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dzig le'ur byas pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sbyag 'tshal ma/ /rtog pa'i dra ba rnam bsal zhing / ba cing rgya che'i sku tāng/'a/ ba/ /spun tu ba nga po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'dzo la phyag 'tshal skye bo phal cher phal la chags shing shes rab rtsal med bas na legs bshad rnams/ /don du mi gnyer kho nar ma da brag dog dri ma dag gis ldang bar yang / /yongs gyur des na bdag la 'di ni gzhan la phan pa yin zhes ba5ma pa'ang med/ / mas ni yun ring legs bshad goms pa lhur len bskyed snyir 'di la dga' ba skyes/ /1 rang don rjes su dpag ba'i le'u/phyogs chos de chas khyab pa yi/ /gtan tshigs de ni rnam gsum nyid/ /1

med na mi 'byung nges snyir ro/ /gtan tshegs ltar snang de las gzhan/ /rgyu la rang bzhin ji snyed cig /med na mi 'byung 'bras bu ni/ gtan tshigs rang bzhin yod tsam dang / /'brel pa can gyi ngo bo yang / /tshad ma rnams ni mi 'jug pa/ /thed la mi 'jug 'bras bu can/ /gtan 8gas bye brag la bstos nas/ /'ga' zhig med shes 'bras bu can 'gal dang 'bras bu dag grub dang / /rgyu dang ngo bo bltar rngang ba'i/ /bdag nyid dag ni ma grub pa/ /med don can mi dmigs rnam bzhi/ /de dang 'gal ba yi ni rgyu/ /dmigs pa'i sbyor ba gang yin de/ /rgyu mtshan dag ni 'gal ba nyid/ /med na 'khrul pa can yin no/ /'gal 'bras la yang yul dang ni/ dus la sogs la bstos par 'dod /gzhan du 'khyul 'gyur mi grang ba/ /sgrub pa la ni thal ba bzhin/ /rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye bar/ /rjes su dpog pa gang yin pa/ /don gzhan la ni mi stos snyir/ /de ni rang bzhin min par brjod/ /tshogs pa'i 'bras bu nus pa rnams/ /'gyur ba dang 'thel 'bras bu la/ skyim nges pa ni nyid yin te/ /gegs byed pa dag srid gyir ro/ /tshogs pa gcig la rag lus pa'i/ /gzugs la sogs pa ros rtogs pa/ /rgyu chos rjes su dpag pa ste/ /du bas bud shing 'gyur ba bzhin/ nus pa 'jug pa med par ni/ /ro med de nyid gzhan gye rgyu/ /skyes/ de/ ltar 'das dus gcig rnams rtogs/ /de ni 'bras bu'i rtags las rgyu ma tshogs pas 'bras bu ni/ /rjes su dpog pa gang yin de/ /lhag ma dang ldan nus med snyir/ /lus las 'dod chags rjes dpog bzhin/ /mi margyan phyogag la ma mthong ba/2/tsam gyis 'bras spyi mthong ba las/ /

gtan 8gas shes pa tshad ltar snang / /ཿga las gas can la sogs bzhin/ /mi mazun phyogs la ma mthong ba/ /tsam gyis 'khrul pa med pa min/ /'khrul pa sgrid pa can nyid snyir/ /sbu ba'i 'bras ni tshos pa bzhin/ /gang zhig ma mthong ba tsam gyis/ /sdog pa rab tu ston byed pa/ /de the tshom rgyu yin gyir/ /de la lhag ma ldan zhes brjod/ /gtan tshigs kyi ni tshul gsum la'ang / /di yis ma grub bzlog don dang / /'khrul pa can gyi gnyen por ni/ /nges pa brjod par mdzad pa yin/ /'khyul pa can gyi gnyen por ni/ /mi mazun chos brjod gang yin pa/ /gal te ma mthong 'bras can de/ /de ma smos kyang rtogam par 'gyur/ /med ces bya ba'i 8ga gis kyang skyi de thed kho na min gal te/ /ji star med rigs de brjod na/ /de tshe med ces bya bar rtogs/ /gal te ma mthong bas sdog 'gyur/ ci ste lhag ldan 'khrul can yin/ /ldog pa can yang gtan 8gas 'gyur/ /ma grub spyor ba brjod bya min/ khyad par rnam par gcad pa yi/ /gtan 8gas su 'argyur ma mthong phyir /tshad ma gzhan gyis gnod ce na/ /da ni ma mthong las med min/ /de bzhin du ni gzhan la yang / /tshad ma gzhan gyis gnod pa srid/ /ma mthong snyir reg mthong ba la/ /mi ldan 'khrul pa med pa can/ /yul la sogs pa'i khyad par las/ /rdzas la nus pa tha dad snang / /de la gcig mthong gzhan la de/ /yod par nges pa rigs ma yin/ bdag dang sa la shes yod sogs/ /med par rab sgrub byed min pa'i/ /ma dmigs gang yin de kho na/ /gtan tshigs med sgrub yin nam ci/ /de snyir de tsam dang ribrel ba'i/ /'o bo nyid kyis ngo bo nyid/ /sdog par 'gyur ba'am rgyu yis ni/ /'bras bu 'khrul pa med pa'i snyir/ /de lta min na gcig log pas/ ji ltar gzhan ni ldog par 'gyur/ /mi la rta me bdog ces te/ /phyugs kyang 3

bdog pa min nam ci/ /de bzhin gcig gcig nye ba'i snyir/ /ji lta gzhaca ni nye bar 'gyur/ /mi la phyugs ni bdog ces te/ /de bzhimu rta ji5nga bdog gam ci/ /de snyir chos mi mthun dpe la/ /nges par 'di la gzhi mi 'dod/ /de dag med na'ang de med ces/ /brjod pa las kyang de rtogs sbyir/ /dpe la de yi ngo bo dang / rgyu dngos de dag mi shes la /ston te mkhas pa rnamaza/ la ni//gtan tshigs 'ga' zhig brjod par zad/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'brel shes na/ /gnyis las gang yang rung smras pas/ /don gyis go bas cig zhos la/ /dran pa yang dag skye bar 'gyur/ /de snyir rgyu dang rang bzhin dag /med pas 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa'i yang / /gtan tshegs yin te dmigs par ni/ /rigs ldan de mi dmigs pa yang / /de ltar mi dmigs 'di rnam gsum/ /bshad kyang rnam pa du ma ste/ /de dang de 'gal la sogs ba/ /ma rtogs rtogs dbye'i spyor sgo nas/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po 'am/ /rang bzhin nges par byed pa las/ /med na mi 'byung nges pa ste/ /ma mthong las min mthongaci'/sa min/ /gzhan du gzhan ri gzhan dag dang / /nges par yod pa'i nges pa gang / /don gzhan rgyu mtshan can gyi skyos/ /yin na gos la tshon bzhin no/ /chos don gzhan gyi rgyu mtshan can/ /yin par gyur na de bzhin nyid/ /snyis 'byung snyir na rgyu nyid min/ /'bras bu na yang ga la nges/ /me yi 'bras bu du ba ste/ /'bras bus chos kyi rjes 'jug gyir/ /de med par ni de yod na/ /rgyu dang ldan pa las 'das 'gyur/ /rgyu med gzhan la mi stos snyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur/ /dngos po rnams ni ris 'ga' zhig /'byung ba bstos pa las yin no//gal te brgya byin spyi bo'i mi'iskyi /rang bzhin yin na de nyid da/ /'on te de na skud+ku—ma'i r+ṣa4 gzhispya mi 1 sgo 7ra lha las rtsu ba 'asprung ༄/ /du ba'i rga yi rang bzhin me/ /de yi nus pa'i bye brag 4ldan/ /du ba du ba'i rgyu min las/ /

'byung na de ni rgyu med 'gyur/ /rjes su 'gro dang ldog pa las/ /gang zhig greng gi rjes 'gror mthong / /de yi rang bzhin de rgyu can/ /de snyir mi mthun las mi 'byung /bsdu ba'i dzigs su bcad pa'o/ /rang bzhin la yang med mi 'byung / /yod pa tsam dang 'brel ba yin/ /de thed na ni yod pa'i bdag /med 'gyur tha dad med snyir ro/ /gang phyir dngos kun rang bzhin gyis/ /rang rang ngo bo la gnas phyir/ /mthun dngos gzhan gyi dngos dag las/ /ldog pa la ni brten pa can/ /de snyir gang dang gang las don/ /sdog pa de yi rgyu can gyi/ /rigs dbye de yi khyad par gyis/ /rtogs 'gyur ba dag rab tu byed/ /de gyir khyad par gang zhig chos/ /gang gis go bar 'gyur ba de/ /de las gzhan gyis nus ma yin/ /des na tha dad rnam par gnas/ /don gyi rang gi ngo bo gcig /bdag nyid mngon sum yin pa la /tshad ma rnams kyis brtag bya gang / /ma mthong cha gzhan ci zhig yod/ /gargyags chos mthun pa mthong ba las/ /nya gyis la dngul rnam pa ltar/ /gal te 'khrul pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /yon tan gzhan sbyor mi byed na/ /de snyir dngos po mthong ba mis/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthong ba nyid/ /'khrul pas nges par mi byed pas/ sgrub pa rab tu 'jug pa yin/ /bsdu ba'i 8gas su bcad pa'o/ /rjes su dpag pa las kyang darngos/ /'dzin na chos gcig nges gyur pas/ /chos kun 'dzin te sel ba la/ /nyes pa 'di ni thal mi 'gyur /de snyir de ltar rtags sel ba'i/ /yul can yin par rab tu bsgrags/ /gzhan du chos can grub gyur na /de las ma grub gzhan ci yod/ /mthong ba 'ga' la'ang shes pa gang / /spyi mi don can rnam rtog pa/ /gzhan gyi cha sgro ma btags pa/ /de tsam la ba'i spyod yuṭ+wāṃ can/ /nges pa dang ni sgro 'dogs

yid/ /gnod bya gnod byed ngo bo'i snyir/ /'di ni sgro 'dogs dben pa la/ /'jug ces bya bar shes pa yin/ /cha shas tho 'dogs ji snyed pa/ /de bsal snyir na nges pa dang / /sgro yang de snyed kho na des/ /de dag spyod yul tha dad can/ /gzhan du dngos po gcig pu pa/ /sgro 'am blo gcig gis khyab na/ /gzhan yul ma yin de yi snyir/ skyirnam grangs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gangagi ltar na blos khyad par/ /sna tshogs can don tha dad 'dzin/ khyad par sna tshogs la phan pa'i/ yan lag nus las dbyer da pa'i/ /bdag nyid bdag nyid spun bzung na/ skyiphan bya'i bye brag gang ma nges/ de dag bdag nyid la 'brel gyir/ /gcig shes na ni gnyis ka bzung / /chos phan nus rnams tha dad na/ /de dag di'i ci yin gal te/ /de yis de dag la phan med/ /de lta yin na thug mid 'gyur/ /gcig la phan byed bzung na ni/ /de la mthong na ma mthong ba/ /phan pa gzhan min de yi snyir/ /di bzung na ni thams cad bzung / /gal te 'khrul pa bzlog pa'i snyir/ /bzung ba la yang gzhan 'dod na/ /de ni rnam gcod yul can grub /de las gzhan pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /sgro 'dogs med pa'i yul la ni/ 'jug snyir gzhan yang ngo bo gang / /nges pa rnams kyis ma nges pa/ de ni ji ltar de yul yin/ /khyod par cha shas rnam spangs ba/ /mngon sum gyis ni bzung ba la'ang / khyad par gang la rtogs pa / /rkyen yod di ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /de la'ang gzhan las ldog pa dang / /gzhan las log pa zhis bya ba'i/ /sgra dang nges pa nyid dag ni/ /bde yi rjes su byed pa yin/ /gnyis kas gcig gcig bsgrod mod gyi/ /brjod bya'i gzhan gye khyad par gyis/ /rnam dbye tha dad 'byed pa yis/ /tha dad don bzhin sgrub par byed/ /6

khyad par gzhan ni thong ba dang / /mi spong ba dag de gnyis kyi/ /bde yi bye brag rtogs pa po'i/ /'dod pa'i rjes su byed pa'i gzhi/ /spun la rdzas dang dngos brjod pa'i/ /sgra yi khyad par 'di nyid do/ /de gyir de dag brjod bya la/ khyad par 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /don de shes par byed 'dod pas/ /de la phan pa'am byed ldan nam/ /gal te gzhan gyis brjod kyang rung / /de las khyad par gzhan med do/ /de gyir gzhan sel yul la ni/ /de ldan phyogs la brjod pa bsal /rigs dang de dang ldan pa dag /tha dad nyid na nyes par 'gyuraskyi /gang dag gi chig dngos po'i dbang /lhur brjod brjod 'dod mi brten paskyi /de dag la drug pa dang / /tsheg dbye la sogs glan ka rigs/ /snyi rol don la mi stos pa'i/ /tshig gang sbo pos ji lta bur/ /rjod byed nyid du nges byed pa/ /de de bzhin du rjod byed yin/ /btsun mo rnams grong drug la sogs/ /tha dad dngos min bzhag pa 'am/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin mkha' nyid ces/ bya ba 'di la rgyu ci yod/ tha dad dngos rnams la brten nas/ /don gcig tu ni snang ba'i blo/ /gang gi rang gi ngo bo mis/ /gzhan gyi ngo bo sgrib byed pa/ /sgrib byed des bdag tha dad kyang / /tha dad pa nyid bsgribs pa yis/ /dngos rnams ngo bo 'ga' zhig gis/ /tha dad min pa lta bur snang / /de la bsam pa'i dbang gis na/ /spyi yod par ni rab tu bsgrags/ /di yis ji lhar kun brtags pa/ /de ni dam pa'i don du med/ gsal ba rnams ni rjes mi 'gro /rjes 'gro gzhan ni snang ba med/ shes las tha dad ma yin pa/ /ji ltar don gzhan 'brang bar 'gyur/ /des na don la bdag gcig tu/ /'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di slog pa/ /ming don 7

gang ldan phan tshun du/ /tha dad 'di yi sa bon yin/ gcig rtogarme don shes la sogs pa /don gcig sgrub la 'ga' zhig ni/ /tha dad min yang rang bzhin gyis/ /nges te dbang po la sogs bzhin/ /dper sman kha cig tha dad kyang / /lhan cig pa 'am so so mis/ /rims la sogs pa zhi byed par /mthong gi gzhan gyis ma yin bzhin/ /khyad par med gyir spyis ma yin /di dag zhing sogs tha dad kyang / /khyad par med par thal 'gyur snyir/ /brtan pas phan 'dogs med snyir mang / /rang bzhin de 'dzin rnam rtog blo/ don med kyang de don can 'dra/ /de yi 'bras can min don las/ /tha dad mthar zug skye ba gang / /de la ngo bo snyi rol dang / /gcig lha gzhan las slog lta bur/ /snang ba gang yin brtag pa yi/ /yan lag med gyir de nyid min/ /shes la yod pa'i don de rnams/ /'di ltar sdog pa'i ngo bo can /des na tha dad min lha bur/ /de nyid gzhan las log par yang / /snang lta de la spyi dang ni/ /gzhi mthun spyod yul can dag gi /shis pa dang ni brjod pa yis/ /tha snyad nor don can rgyas byed/ /dngos po rnams kyi de kun yang / /phan tshun mid la brten pa ste/ /des na gzhan sel yul can dang / /gang la dngos dang 'brel yod pa/ /dngos po rnyed pa'i rten yin te/ /rjes dpag ji skad bshad ji bzhin/ /'khrul par 'dra yang gzhan las min/ /mar me'i 'od las nor bu bzhin/ de la du ma'ang 'bras gcig can/ /di 'bras can min gzhan rten can/ /brjod dang shes pas gcig nyid du/ /tha snyad rab tu 'jug par byed /de bzhin gcig kyang du ma byed/ /de dngos yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ /de 'bras can min don las ni/ /tha dad pas chos sna tshogs shes/ /sgra don 'di dang gzhi mthun nyid/ 8

yod pa min yang ji lta bur/ /grags pa bzhin du brjod pa ste/ /dngos la 'di ni mi grid do/ /chos dang chos can rnam gzhag dang / /tha dad tha dad min ci 'dra/ /de nyid don ni ma brtags par/ /'jig rten ji lhar grags de la/ /de bzhin kho nar brten nas ni/ /bsgrub ba sgrub pa kun bzhag pa/ /dam pa'i don la 'jug bya'i snyir/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa yin/ /dam pa'i don gyi don nams ni/ /rang gis 'dre dang tha dad med/ /de la ngo bo gcig pa dang / /du ma blo yis bslad pa yin/ /de spyi khyad par zhes bya ba'i/ /bye brag 'di ni blo don la/ /de nyid la gzhan las ldog pas/ /chos kyi bye brag rab tu brtag /bsgrob bya sgrub par rtog pa la/ /dngos po mthong ba nyams pa'i snyir/ /khyod par spyi dang 'dres pa 'dir/ /rang gi mtshan nyid gzung bya min/ /de ni spyi dang khyad par gyi/ /rnam sogs cir yang gzung bya min/ /bye brag khyad par mang po rnams/ /de gcig la ni mi rung snyir/ /de yi ngo bo kun las log /de de bzhin du rtogs byed pa'i/ /sgra yod ma yin rtog pa yang / /spyi nyid du ni 'jug snyir ro/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i 8gas su bcad pa'o/ /sgro rnams kyis ni brdar btags ston/ /de ni tha snyad ched du byas/ di tshe rang gi mtshan nyid mid/ /des na de la brdar ma min/ /ci nas skyes bu don byed par/ /nus pa shes nas de bsgrub snyir/ /'jug par 'gyur zhes don rnams la/ /rjod par byed pa sbyor bar byed/ /de la rigs don byed rung min/ /de ldan nus pa de yang ni/ /ci snyir dngos su sbyor mi byed/ /gal te mtha' yas snyir 'di mtshungs/ /de byid di byed ma yin las/ /log par mtshungal la cis ma byas/ /de ldan nyes mtshungs snyir zhe na/ /bla ste rigs 9

gzhan mi dgos so/ /de las gzhan pa yongs spangs nas/ /'jug 'gyur zhes kyang sgra brjod de/ /de yis de dag rnams las 'di/ /mi gartsod na ni de ji ltar/ /gal te 'di la rnam gtsod yod/ /sgra rnams dgos pa de tsam du/ /zad pa min nam khyed la der/ /snyi gzhan gyis ni ci zhig bya/ /gsal ba rnams ni tha dad kyaji / bya ba de dang di byed pa'i/ /don rnams mthong nas gzhan mthong yang / /de las gzhan dang bral ba yi/ spul can gyi ni sgra rnams kyis/ /lhan cig sbyar nas ngo shes byed/ /gzhan gyi ltar na'ang blo de ni/ /snyi 'ba' zhig nyid las min/ /rtag tu de tsam rnam shes na/ gsal ba mi she thal 'gyur snyir/ /de yi tshe na nam yang ni/ /de ldan 'athrol pa ma bzung snyir/ de dang ldan nges mi 'gyur bas/ /de la ji ltar tha snyad 'dogs/ /gal te dngos gcig grogs byed pa'i/ /gsal rnams shes pa'i rgyu zhe na/ /dngos po gcig nges de rnams kyi/ /tha dad pa nyid sel tam ci/ /tha dad snyir yang de rnams la/ /gcig gi rnam shes rgyur mi 'dod/ /gal te du ma'ang gcig bstos nas/ tha dad min blo skyed ce na/ /de dag so so med par yang / /de gcig gis kyang bskyed bya ba'i/ /blo la de rnams nus med snyir/ blo yis 'dzin pa med pa yin/ /sngo sogs mig gi rnam shes la/ /nus pa so sor mthong ba'i snyir/ /tshags la'ang nus grub gsal ba la/ /ji ltar yang ni de ltar min/ /gal te de dag gang rung la/ /bstos nas des nus 'ba' zhig min/ /de dag de gcig la phan na/ /ji ltar blo gcig nyid la min/ /'di de rnams gyi 'bras bur 'gyur/ /phan 'dogs gang yin skyed pa yin/ /gal te tha dad 10

min snang blo/ /tha dad rnams la mi 'dod na /blo yi snang ba tha dad de/ /de dag mtshungs zhes 'dzin phyir ro/ /gal te de dag mtshungs na ni/ /ji ltar tha dad blos gasgrong bya/ /'bras bu gcig 'dra de dag gi /'bras blo de yang tha dad do/ zhe na gcig tu rtogs rgyu'i phyir/ /blo ni tha dad med pa yis/ /blo gcig rgyu yi dngos po yis/ /gsal ba rnams kyang tha mi dad/ /di yang de 'bras can min bral/ /de las gzhan pa rjes 'gro ba'i/ /dngos ma mthong snyir bkag snyir yang / /brda ni de rig don can yin/ /de byed min la de byed dang / /'dra ba'i ngo bor snang ba can/ /dngos po tha dad dngos tsam gyi/ /sa bon can don thed pa'i blo/ /skyed par byed pa'ang de mi byed/ /yongs spangs yan lag ja bo'i snyir/ /dngos po tha dad rten can snyir/ /don la mi smyu yod par 'dod/ /de gyir gzhan bel yul can te/ /de byed brten pa'i ngo bo'i gyir/ / nga ma min las ldog pa mis/ /shing don 'dzin na gnyis po dag /phan tshun brten pas gcig 'dzin ba/ med na gnyis ka mi 'dzin 'gyur/ /de mi snyir na brdar btags pa/ /mi srid do zhes kha cig smra/ /de dag gi gi brdar 'dogs la/ /ging min rnam par gcod dam min/ /gal te rnam gcod zhing gi don/ /'dzin pa thed na ji ltar shes /brda las de dag mi sel na/ /tha da 'dogs par byed pa rnams/ de yongs spangs nas 'jug par ni/ /mi 'gur shing gi khyad par bzhin/ /gal te gzhan bkag mi sgrub par/ /mdun gnas gcig gcig rab bstan nas/ /'di ging yin zhes brda byed la/ /tha snyad 'dogs pa'i tshe na yang / /de rtogs 'gyur la de mi gyir/ /’sa pa 'di gi med snyam na/ /'di yang skang yin 'di kho na/ /zhes bya'i thal ba sdog pa med//gcig rtogs zhes bya'i shes pa ni/ /gcig la gnas pa'i rtogs pa

pos/ de dang de min rgyu don rnams༈ /bdag nyid rnam par 'byid par byed/ /blo de la ni yod pa'i dngos/ /blo rgyu nyid du snang ba dang / /rgyu min ngo bo bral ba dang / /ngo bo gcig 'drar bdag nyid kyis/ /tha dad par gi shes 'gyur bas/ /tha dad pa la skad sbyor te/ /de las de rtogs 'gyur ba'i blo/ 'khrul pas dngos po gcig ltar rtogs/ blo don 'ga' lag rnam bzlog nas/ /don 'ga' zhig la 'jug bya'i snyir/ /sgra ni rab tu sbyor byed de /di don nges par gzung snyir ro/ /gzhan du sbyor ba don med 'gyur/ /des na shes bya la sogs 8ga /tha snyad du ni 'jog rnams la/ rnam par gartsod pa 'ga' zhig yod/ gang zhig gang las tha dad ba/ /de rnam bzlog nas de dag las/ /tha dad khyad par mtshungs pa'i rgyu/ /rnam pa snang ba can la 'god/ /de nyid gzhan las sdog pa yis/ /dngos po de yi cha 'ga' zhig /rtogs 'argyur zhis pas rab tu bshad/ /'di la'ang ngo bo cung da mid/ /sgra rnams las de rtogs nyid kyis/ /gzhan bsgrog rtogs 'gyur di la ni/ /'ga' yis khyad par du byas pa rtogs par 'gyur ba gzhan 'ga' da/ sgra gnyis byed pa'ang ma yin te/ /phan tshun yod pa min phyir 'di/ /dngos med dngos po ldan nyid du/ /mthong ba blo yis bslad pa yin/ de nyid gyir 'di don dam min/ /gzhan du dngos po las sdog pa/ /dajas por mi 'gyur 'di 'di las/ /tha dad ces ni brjod snyir ro/ /'dres pa'i don gcig gcod pa na/ sgra 'am rtags ni gcig pu yis/ /bya byed de la bcad pa yi/ /dngos po'i brjod bya ci yang med/ /gang gis rjod par byed pa las/ /ma lus par ni rtogs 'gyur ba/ /dngos po'i nus pa yin nges na/ /'bras bu du ma rten gcig 'gyur/ 12

rnam gcod gcig gcig ston pa na/ /gang tshe gzhan mi sprong bar gnas/ /des ni de khyab gcig pu'ang snang / /de tshe blo yi ngor byas nas/ /gzhi mthun pa ni nyid du 'gyur/ /sgra ni rnam garnyod byed pa na/ /dngos po'i chos la reg 'gyur ba/ /de ni de la yod ces bya'o/ /dngos po gcig ni rjod byed min/ /blo la snang min snang rung la/ /dngos po med pas nges phyir ro/ /de snyir gzhan sal yul can gyi/ /sgra rnams dang ni blo nyid kyang / /spyi yi yul can du bstan te/ /dngos la de dag mi srid snyir/ /dngos po'i ngo bo gcig nyid phyir/ /ngo bo tha dad blo gang las/ /gcig ni rjes su 'gro sdog gi /don gcig spyod yul can ma yin/ /tha dad gyur na dbyer med pa'i/ /tha snyad dag kyang rgyu med 'gyur/ /ldog pa kun la yod pa'i snyir/ /thal 'gyur nyes pa de dag med/ /de yi 'bras bu yongs bstan snyir/ /tha dad 'bras bu gcig dag la/ /gin pos sgra gcig brdar byas pa/ /de yi 'bras bu med pa can/ /ldog pa yi ni rgyu can yin/ /tha dad pa dag bstan pa ni/ /dka' dang mi nus 'bras med snyir/ /dngos po la min dngos po kun/ /rang rang ngo bo la gnal snyir/ /ba bo yi ni ngo bo gang / /de ni ser skya la yod min/ /de 'bras yin min las bzlog pa/ /gnyis ka la yang yod pa yin/ /don la tha dad med par yang / /spa yi tha dad mi rigs so/ /de snyir de 'thas 'dod na yang / /de 'bras med las tha dad nyid/ /dasprer na mig la sogs pas gzugs/ /rnam shes gcig gi 'bras bu ca na/ /gang snyir khyod par med 'bras de/ ston pa dag ni srid par 'gyur/ /'ga' zhig cig car kun rtogs ṭ+wāṃr/ /de yi ngo po snyi las ni/ /tha

dad men du zin na yang / /bde las byung ba bsnyad par bya/ gal te gcig gnas pa yi phyir/ /mang po dag la'ang mnyan pa gcig /gnas pa rten nam gsal ba yin/ /de star de la mi rigs so/ rtags la phan 'dogs med pa'i gyir/ /rten min snang ba'i tshul can gyi/ /rgya shug sogs la'ang de yi yul/ /skyed pa 'khar gzhong sogs pas nus/ /de yang de la mi srid do/ /de med na ming gnas pa'i phyir/ /gnas min de yang mi rigs te/ tha dad tha dad min pa mi/ rnam par daphyod pas mi rigs nyid/ /bdag la rnam shes skyed rung ba'i /don du gzhan gyi ngor byed gang / /gsal bya yin la rung nyid kyi/ /byed pa po yang rgyu ru 'dod /'di ni snga nas rung nyid na/ /de la stos pa mi rung lta/ /'gyur ba med pa'i snyir de ni/ /spyi ldan pa las gang las yin/ /mig sman sogs bzhin gsal ba las/ /dbang po'ang 'du byed ma yin te/ /de ni yod med dus dag la/ rtogs pa tha dad med snyir ro/ /rigs rnams kyi ni gsal byed kung / /gal te rigs dang ldan 'dod na/ sgron me la sogs gsal byed ni/ /ba lang nyid sogs de ldan 'thob/ /gang dag rigs ni gsal ba las/ /gzhan nam gzhan min yod nyid de'i/ /sngon med gsal ba rnams la ni/ /spyi yi blo gros ji ltar yin/ /gcig la yod pa mthong ba ni/ /gzhan la mthong ba mi srid phyir/ /gzhan nyid min na rjes 'gro med /gzhan nyid na yang rten min snyir/ /mi 'gro de na yod pa'ang min/ /phyis yod cha dang ldan pa'ang min/ /rten snga ma ni yongs mi 'dor/ /kyi ma phongs ju/'i rgya nyid yin/ /gzhan la gnas par gyur pa ni/ /rang spu / 0/nas las mi g.yo zhing / /de las gnas gzhan skye ba la/ /gnas na ska na tu rigs par ldan/ /gang na dngos de gnas gyur pa/ /der ni 'brel pa'ang ma yin la/ /de dag yul can la khyab 14

pa/ /ci ga de ni ngo mtshar che/ /gal te kun na rigs yod na/ /gcig tu gsal bas de gsal nyid/ /tha dad med gyir kun tu mthong / /de yang gsal ba la bstos min/ /gsal byed rtogs pa ma yin na/ /gsal bya yang dag rtogs pa min/ /spyi dang de dang ldan pa dag ci yi phyir na bzlog par 'dod/ /tha dad med don med par yang / /'tshed pa po sogs brjod pa yin/ /tha dad snyir na las rgyu min/ /'di yi rigs min las 'brel snyir/ /mnyan pa gzhan gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /las kyang gnas pa yod ma yin/ /'brel pa med snyir sgra yi rgyu/ /spyi yin mi rigs min pa min/ /ha cang thal snyir las thed na'ang / /shis rjod dag gi ma yin te/ /rgyu mtshan can min thob phyir ro/ /rjes 'gro med snyir nus pa'ang min/ /gal te 'tshed po nyid sogs snyi/ /dang po nyid du de yod sogs/ /bzhin du gsal 'gyur min na ni/ khyad par med phyir gyis mi 'gyur /bya bas phan 'dogs stos gsal byed/ /min na 'gyur med stos pa med/ /'di ni phul byung yod na yang / /skad cig nyid phyir bya gang las/ /tha dad mtshungs pa yin na rigs/ /nye ba gang gis 'ga' zhig la/ /rab 'jug gzhan la min de nyid/ /sgra dang shes pa'i rgyu yin no/ /gal te sdog pa spangs pa yi/ /dngos po'i rjes 'gro gzhan med na/ /gcig gi 'bras bu gzhan gyir min/ /skan tu tha dad snyir zhe na/ /gal te bdag nyid gcig pa yis/ /du ma 'bras bu gcig byed na/ /bdag nyid gcing/ la'ang de yod gyir/ /lhan cig byed pa don med 'gyur/ /tha dad med pa'i ngo bo de/ /mi 'gro khyad par rnam nges bral/5 /

gcig dang bral na 'bras med phyir bye brag rnams las de dag 'byung //don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ /de nyid don dam yod pa yin/ /de yang rjes 'gro med gang zhig /rjes 'gro de las 'bras mi 'byung / /de na bdag nyid tha dad kyang / /'ga' zhig rgyu yi gi gzhan pa min/ /rang bzhin 'di yin tha dad pa/ /med na cig car skye 'jig 'gyur/ /de las tha dad pas de ltar/ /mi 'gyur zhe na gcig 'jig tshe/ /bdag gnas na ni de yi min/ /des na spyi khyad blor mi 'gyur/ /ldog pa ngo bo nyid med gir/ /gnas dang mi gnas rtog rnga/ minaskyi /spyi yi blo yang bslad pa yin/ /de phyir sun dbyung ba yang med/ /de yi skyed byed ngo bo gang /de las gzhan pas ji ltar skyed/ tha dad khyad par nyid skyed byed/ /de la tha dad min pa'ang yod/ /ce na des de skyed min brjod/ /snang ba'ang gzhan la mi brten pas/ /tha dad byed min de nyid don/ /de ni gzhan las log pa yin/ /de ni rgyu dong 'bras bur bshad /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod/ /de ni blang dor 'bras can pas/ /skyes bu thams cad 'jug pa yin/ /ji ltar tha dad med khyad med/ /na yang thams cad kun sgrub min/ /de bzhin tha dad khyad med na'ang / /thams cad kun gyi sgrub byed min/ /tha dad na yang dngos po yi/ /chos nyid kyis 'ga' byed por 'gyur/ /tha dad med na'ang gcig nyid kyi/ /byed dang mi byed 'gal bar 'gyur/ /tha dad yod de'i snyir bya med/ /ce na lhani cig byed mi byed/ /'on te rim bzhin byed po nyid/ /de ci dngos de nyid kyi 'am/ /de ldan dngos po skan tu ni/ /tha dad tha dad med 'gyur ba'am/ /'dra dang mi 'dra'i bdag nyid can/ /rna / grangs phan tshurtsa ni tha 16

dad 'gyur /de yang tha dad 'gyur zhe na/ /bdag nyid gang gis de dag gi khyad par spyi zhes bya ba de gal te de dag tha dad na/ /tha dad nyid 'gyur de lta na'ang / /ji ltar bum sogs phan tshun bzhin/ /sbyi dang khyad par du 'dod pa'ang / /spyi dang khyad par can mi 'gyur /gang gi bdag nyid mdun byas nas/ /bsgrub bya de 'bras 'dod pa can/ /skyes bu 'di ni 'jug par 'argyur/ /de rten tha dad tha dad med/ /dpyad bya rang bdag nyid tha dad/ /ldog pa mtshungs pa 'di dag ni/ /yod nyid dngos po rjes 'gro med/ /'jug pa la sogs thal 'argyur snyir /de nyid kyis ni 'dzem med pa/ /mun sprul gang ci'ang rung smra ba/ /de dag kyang ni bsal ba yin/ /mtha' gcig pa ni srid snyir ro/ /thams cad gnyis ka ngo bo nyid/ /de yi khyad par bgal ba'i phyir/ /zho 'thung zhes ni bskul ba na/ /ci snyir rnga mo la mi rgyug /'on te phul byung 'ga' zhig yod/ /gang gis khyad par 'jug 'gyur na /de nyid zho yin de gzhan la/ /med gyir gnyis ka min gzhan min/ /thams cad kun bdag nyid min na/ /blo sgro tha dad par mi 'argyur/ /tha dad bajus par smra ba la/ /de med snyir na mi grid 'argyur/ /dngos med ngo bo med pa'i snyir/ /ngo bo brjod pa dpyad bya nyid/ ma yin sgra gi de dag nyid/ /rnam gcod rjod par byed par grub/ /rang bzhin khyad par bye brag la/ /stos pa'am 'on te 'ba' zhig pa/ /bsgrub bya sgrub pa'i snyir brjod de/ /'jig la 'bras dang yod nyid ba na/ /gal te gtan tshigs yod rang bzhin/ /yod pa ji ltar bsgrub bya min/ khyid par rjes 'gro med pa ni/ /gtan tshigs bsgrub bya dag las /༷sa/ /yod pa'i khyad par tsam du ni/

bsgrub bya snyi chos can la/ /don 'ga' zhig yang 'grub mi 'gyur/ 'di 'dra ba yang bkag pa med/ khyad par bsgrub byar bzung na 'dir/ /gtan gas rīs 'gro thed can 'gur/ /yod pa bsgrub bya yin na des/ khyodapar dag ni bsgrub byar 'argyur/ /de mi khyad par gzung nad par/ /dngos po tsam na sgrub pa na/ /de tsam khyab byed bsgrub bya yi/ /rjes su 'gro ba nyams pa med/ /ma grub pa la yod chos med/ /gnyis ka la brten 'khrul pa can/ /med pa'i chos ni 'gal yin na/ yod de ji ltar ba ba byar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin sgrub pa go byed yin/ /de la khyab byed nges pa yin/ /rang bzhin nges pa go bya yin/ /'di sdog pa na de ldog byed/ /dasprer na mi rtag nyid byas pa'am/ /ma byas pas na mi 'jig bzhin/ /rgyu med snyir na 'jig pa na/ /rang gi ngo bos rjes 'brel nyid /dngos po stos dang bcas rnams ni/ /nges par 'gyur ba med par mthong / /de rgyu mang po yod na yang / /'ga' zhig la ni mi srid 'gyur/ /des na 'bras gnas med pa'i snyir/ /'jig pa rgyu ldan sbo rnams kyi/ 1'jig pa'i rgyu ni thams cad dag /'khrul pa nyid du bshad pa yin/ /de rgyu nus pa med snyir yang / /'di ni ngo bo nyid kyis 'argyur/ /gang la 'gyur zhes bya de las/ /gzhan la'ang ngo bo nyid kyis 'gyur/ /des na dngos po'i yul can gyi//rjes su dpog gang rnam gnyis te/ /'bras dang ngo bo de dag las/ /rang baspyob bya la 'brel des snyir/ /'jug pa blo rjon can nyid gyir/ /de yi ngo bo mi dmigs na/ /'jug par mi byed ces bya bas/ /mi dmigs pa ni tshad mar bshad/ /bstan bcas skabs dang 'brel med dang / /don rnams dbang po las 'das pa/ rtags med pa can de rnams ni/ /mi dmigs gyir na ji ltar med/ /yod med nges pa'i 'bras can min/ phyir na tshad ma nyid mi 'gyur/ /8

rtags kyi phul byung yod pa can/ /la la tshad ma dag tu 'argyur/ /rang bzhin shes byed mi shes la/ /rigs pa 'di ni brjod pa yin/ /rgyu mi shes na 'bras bu ni/ /thed pa nyid du sgrub par byed/ /rdon gyi rang bzhin rtags can la/ /rang bzhin mi dmigs pa yang yin/ /gal te gtan tshigs 'ga' zhig gis/ /de med par ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /snang rung mthong ba med pa'i rgyu/ /mi srid par ni gyur pa na/ /snang rung dngos po ma dmigs pa'i/ /dngos po med pa rtogs par 'argyur/ /'gal pa'i dngos po yod na yang / /de yod pa la gnod byed snyir/ /de dang 'gal ba dmigs pa ni/ /med pa nyid du nges par 'gyur/ /thog thed bag chags las byung ba'i/ /rnam par rtog pas yongs bsgrubs pa/ /yod med gnyis ka la brten pa/ /sgra don chos ni rnam pa gsum/ de dngos nyer len med pa can/ /sgrub la de mi dmigs pa ni/ /de ltar gtan 8gas de nyid ni/ /med pa ma min sgra spyor snyir/ /don dam gcig tu 'jug nyid can/ /mthong ba'i bye brag tha dad pa'i/ /don rnams la ni sgra rnams ni/ /rgyu med can 'jug mi 'gyur dang / /'das dang ma skyes pa la yang / /tshig 'ga' zhig kyang rdzun pa yi/ /don can nyid du mi 'argyur snyir/ /de dag blo don yul can 'dod/ /sgra don bston pa sgrub pa la/ /chos kyi rten ni bsal ba'i snyir/ tshogs pa bsgrub byar mi 'gyur la/ /yan gar chos ni grub pa yin/ /sgra don bston pa med rnams kyis/ / klo/da med phyogs kyi bye brag gis/ dngo po nyid gi dpyad bya ste/ /'di las 3bras 'byung rag las phyir/ /don byed nus pa ma yin la/ /don gnyer brtags pas ci zhig bya/ /ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes/ /'dod ldan rnams kyis brtags ci phan/ /sdi9

rtog pa'i shes pa'i yul nyid kyis/ /sgra yi don ni brtags pa yin/ /dngos rten ma grub 'di skyos su/ /rig pa smra bas gsungs pa yin/ /sgra rnams dngos dang lhan cig tu/ / zed na mi 'byung nyid med snyir/ /de las don grub min de dag /smra po'i bsam pa ston par byed/ /yid 'ches 8ga ni mi smyu ba'i/ /spyi las rjes su dpag pa nyid/ /'brel pa dang ni rjes mthun thabs/ /skyes bu'i don ni rjod byed dag /yongs brtags dbang du byas yin gyi/ /de las gzhan pa'i dbang byas min /mthong dang ma mthong dngos po yi/ /don de dag la mngon sum dang / /rjes su dpag rnam gnyis kyis kyang / /gnod med 'di yi mi slu ba'o/ /yid 'ches 8ga ni mi sku ba'i/ /spyi las 'di yul skog rgyur na'ang /go skobs med pa'i snyir zlo ni/ /rjes su dpag pa nyid du gsungs/ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs bcas rab tu nges pa yis/ /gtso bo'i don la mi slu'i phyir/ /gzhan la rjes su dpag pa yin/ /skyes bu phul byung la bstos pa/ /ji bzhin don du gzhan gyis shes/ /gal te phul du byung ba de/ /shes par nus na don 'di 'dod/ /'di ni 'di lta'am min no zhes/ /gzhan la skyon ldan skyon med la'am/ tshad ma rnams ni rnyed dka'i phyir/ /rtogs dka' zhes ni gzhan gyis shes/ /'grib dang phul byung brten pa kun/ /mi mthun phyogs dang bcas nyid snyir /de goms pa las bdag 'gyur bas/ /la la zag pa zad par 'gyur/ /'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /ngo bo nyid la snyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /nyes pa rnam pa tham sa cad dag /'jig tshogs lta las skyes pa yin/ /de ma rig der de la chags/ /de las zhe ldang la sogs 'byung / /de nyid kyis na nyes rnams kyi/ /20

rgyu ni gti mug yin par gsungs/ /gzhan las 'jig tshogs lta ba ste/ /de spangs pa na spong snyir ro/ /8ga rnams log pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /nyes rnams skyes bu la brten phyir/ /skyes bus ma byas bden don can/ /zhes ni la la rjod par byed/ /tshig rnams bden pa nyid kyi rgyu/ /yon tan skyes bu la brten snyir/ /skyes bus ma byas log pa'i don/ /cis min zhes ni gzhan dag brjod/ /don shes byed pa dag gi rgyu/ /brda ni skyes bu la brten pas/ /tsheg rnams skyes bus byas min yang / /de snyir log pa nyid du zed/ /'brel pa skyes bus byas min na/ /brda rig med par rtogs par 'gyur/ /brda las de ni gsal yin na/ /brtags pa gzhan dag nus med 'gyur/ /chig rnams don gcig la nges na/ /don gzhan rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /don du ma dang mngon 'brel na/ /'gal ba gsal bar byed pa yin/ /skyes bus ma byas pa nyid kyang / /kun tu brtags pa don med 'gyur/ /tha dad rnams la 'brel pa yang / /rnam par gzhag snyir gtan chigs brjod/ /skyes bus legs par ma byas pa/ /rnam pa kun tu don med 'gyur/ /legs byas khas len na 'di ni /dngos su glang chen khrus 'drar 'gyur/ /'brel pa can rnams mi rtag phyir/ /'brel pa la rtag yod ma yin/ /de phyir don dang sgra yi de/ /skyes bu'i blo yis legs par byas/ /don dang lhan cig skyes na ni/ /sgra rnams la ni rang bzhin dag /rnam par bzlog par mi rigs so/ /rnam brtags 'brel la nyes 'di med/ gal te rten 'di 'jig na yang / /'jig min rtag snyir rigs dang 'dra/ /rtag rnams la brten nus pa gang / /gang gis de rten 'dod pa yisdu// /shes pa skyed par byed pa yis/ /

lhan cig byed rgyu rnams tshogs na/ /de skyed par ni rung nyid phyir/ /rigapa shes pas bum sogs kyang / /skye ba la ni gsal bar 'dod/ /'gyur ba med rnams khyad med pas/ /gsal byed rang gis don ci byas/ /gang snyir des de gsal 'dod pa/ /'brel pa dngos po nyid gyur mod /tha dad snyir blo sna tshogs 'gyur/ /de las tha dad min de nyid/ /'di las gzhan dngos yod ma yin/ /dngos po'i ngo bo tha dad gyir/ /'brel pa rtog pas byas pa yin/ /yod rdzas gzhan la rag lus pa'am/ /gzhan gyi 'brel par ji ltar 'gyur/ yi ge don med can 'gyur zhing / /tsheg sogs kun brtags dngos thed la/ /dngos po yi ni 'brel pa 'di/ /ji lta bur ni 'jug par 'gyur / byed pa po rnams mi dran gyir/ /gyis bus ma byas kyang 'dod lo/ /'di la'ang rjes su brjod pa yod /des na ngan pa'i mun pas khyab/ /ji ltar skyes bu 'di gzhan las/ /ma thos bar ni yi ge dang / /8ga bkod pa ni brjod nus med/ /de ltar gzhan la'ang 'ga' zhig sbo/ /spel ba yi ni gzhung gzhan yang / /man ngag las gzhan gzhan dag gis/ /'don pa gang mthong gang gis na/ /de yang de ltar rjes mi dpog /rigs gang gang las grub pa de/ khyad par med de me shing bzhin/ /rgyu ma mthong ba can gzhan yang / /de las 'gyur bar yang dag shes/ /de la 'bras mtshungs mthong ba'i snyir/ khyad par dag ni ma bstan paraskyi /gtan tshegs rab tu sgos pa gang / /de dag thams cad 'khrul pa can/ /rnam kun thog med grub gyur mod/ /di ltar skyes min rten can min/ /de phyir skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /gzhan yang mi la mi brten 'gyur/ /gla klo sa sogs tha snyad dang / /med par smra ba'i 8ga rnams kyang / /thog med phyir na de bzhin 'gyur/ /sngon 'dus byas pa'i rgyu yin snyir/ /de 22

'dra'i skyes bus ma byas nyid/ /grub na'ang yon tan ci zhig yod/ /don gyi 'du byed khyad par rnams/ /mthong snyir the tshom dag kyang yin/ /yig rnams gzhan dang khyad med phyir/ /sbob par byed na 'bras cir 'gur/ /ngag ni yi ge las tha dad/ /yod pa min te ma dmigs snyir/ /yan lag du ma'i bdag nyid yin/ /de rnams tha dad don med nyid/ /de dngos can min de dngos can/ /brtags pa seng ge nyid sogs bzhin/ /ri re don bcas nyid yin nam/ /du ma nyid btags log pa min/ /yan lag gcig ni rtogs pas kyang / /ngag gi don dag rtogs par 'gyur/ /thams cad cig car rtogs pa na'ang / /dus kyi khyad par mi rung ngo / /gcig nyid na yang tha dad med/ /rim gyis rtogs pa mi srid gyir/ /mi rtag na ni rtsol byung snyir/ /de ci skyes bus byas pa min/ /rtag nyid yin yang rtag par ni/ /dmigs 'gyur sgrib g.yogs thed snyir ro gal te lhan cig byed 'ga' zhig /ma tshad thog pa min zhe na/ /cis kyang gzhan stos yin sla ste/ nges pa dag ni 'gal ba min/ /gal te de dag khyab byed min/ /thams cad du ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /gal te khyab na thams cad kyis/ /cig car dmigs pa dag tu 'gyur/ /'dus byas dmigs pa yin na yang / /'gyur sked gang gis 'du byed 'gyur/ /dbang po legs par byas gyur na/ /des kyang ma lus thos par 'gyur/ /gal te legs byas khyad par las/ /tha dad gyir don gcig nges yin/ sgra yi tshogs pa du ma yi/ ca co ji ltar thos par 'gyur/ /de la gal te sgra yan gar/ /thos 'gyur rjod byed ma yin na/ /sgra las tha dad yod do zhes /'di la shin tu ches dad bya/ /sgra gzhan2 ṭ+wāṃg ni gnas pa na/ /rjod byed ji ltar

thos pa yin/ /yang na nus pa nges pa'i snyir/ /ji ltar tha dad sgra rtogs 'gyur/ /’sa pa gang dang gang gis kyang / /sgra tsam rjod byed mi 'dod pa/ /sgra tsam dag gis gsal ba ni/ /ji ltar rjod byed la di med/ /gal te mi gi rim pa dag /mig rnams tha dad med snyir min/ /de dag rnam par gzhag pa'ang mid/ /go rim gzhan ni 'gal snyir ro/ /khyob dang rtag par brjod pa'i snyir/ /yul dang dus kyi go rim med/ /mi rtag khyab byed ma yin pa'i skyon yang sngar ni brjod pa yin/ /gsal ba'i rim pa'ang ngag min te/ /rtag la gsal ba gsal snyir ro /byed pa rnams kyi bya nyid las/ /di grub snyir na 'bras nyid yin/ /grub pa'i don la rab shes pas/ /gzhan blo'i rgyu ni gsal byed 'dod/ /dper na sgron bzhin gzhan du na'ang / /byed po las 'di khyad par ci/ byed pa rnams kyi tshogs pa mi/ /bya ba las ni nges par yang / dmigs snyir 'bras bu nyid yin te/ /gsal byed la de mi srid snyir/ /gal te khyed kyi de ngo bo'i/ /sgrib byed bral ba gsal yin na/ ci gyir med pa la byed pa'i/ /tshogs kyi nus ba di rung 'gyur/ /sgra dang khyod par med pa'i snyir/ /gzhan dag kyang gsal thob par 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni khas len na/ /rgyu rnams kun ni don med nyid/ /ngo shes pa dang yong sbyor sogs/ /gang yin sgrub byed 'dod na ni/ /dpe med can yin dngos rnams ni/ /skad cig gis ni 'jig snyir ro/ /rtags ngan gzhan sang sun dargyung bya/ /zlo ni skyes bu'i rten can min/ khas blangs mngon sum grags pa dang /rjes su dpag pas cig car gnod/ /mi ge rnams las tha dad pa'i/ 2/4rim pa'ang gsal bar dpyad zin to/ /

de ni rtog pas sgro btags na/ /ji ltar skyes bu'i rten can min/ /'jig pa yod tsam 'brel pa can/ nyid phyir sgro ni mi rtag nyid/ /the las don gzhan gyur pa dag /skye na 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ /shing ni mthong ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de nyid 'di yis 'jig ce na/ /ji ltar gzhan ni gzhan 'jig 'gyur/ /bla ste ci snyir shing mi snang / /des gzung snyir min zhe na min/ /gang phyir de yis mi sgrib ste/ skye phyir 'jig pa 'jig can 'gyur/ /de lta na yang shing mthong 'gyur/ /gal te gsod byed bsad pa na/ /nag pa smar 'argyur min ji bzhin/ /'di la'ang de bzhin yin zhe na/ /gsod byed bsad pa nyid ma yin/ /'jig pa gzhan nyid ma yin na/ /skang nyid 'jig pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de med snyir na rgyu min nyid/ /'di las gzhan pa'i rnam pa'ang med/ /'jig pa rgyu med can yin na'ang / /rtag snyir dngos po 'jig pa dag /lhan cig yod par 'gyur zhe na/ /med pa rtag nyid gang las yin/ /med la dngos 'jig med nyid kyi/ thal bar 'gyur ba mi rung ste/ /gang snyir dngos po 'jig pa yis/ /'jig pa dag ni mi 'dod do/ /dngos 'jig gzhan la stos med phyir /de shes don du sems kyis ni/ /de zhi tha dad sgro btags nas/ /gnas bas de rgyu med can bshad/ /med pa rang nyid las yod na'ang / /rnam rtog 'di ni mtshungs she na/ /de yi cung zad 'gyur med de/ /med par gyur pa tsam zhig yin/ /yod la rnam rtog 'di 'gyur te/ /bsgrub pa dngos dang 'brel snyir ro/ med pa yin zhes gsungs pa ni/ /dngos po min zhes bya ba'ang yin/ /gal te bya ba cung zad cig /yod na gzhan la stos 'gyur gyi/ /dngos gangacicung zad mi byed la/ /ci ste 'ga' zhig gis stos 'gyur/ /des ni rgyu med 25

can yin na'ang / /ma skyes pa las 'jig 'gyur snyir/ /yod pa nyid dang 'jig yin skyon/ /ha cang thal ba bsal ba yin/ /ji ltar skye ldan 'ga' zhig nyid/ /thogs bcas nyid 'dod de bzhin du/ /yod rnams 'jig pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /skye ldan min pa min zhe na/ /rgyu yi rang bzhin nges pa las/ /'bras bu'i rang bzhin nges pa ste/ /tha dad rgyu rnams med nyid snyir/ /mi rtag ngo bo tha dad med/ /di phyir de rnams 'brel pa mang / /rtag pa nyid ni bsal ba yin/ /yin/ sgra/ yi nus pa'ang sngar bshad pa'i /'asbolapa'i skyon gyis bsal ba skyes bus ma byas zhes bya nyid/ /ji bzhin don shes sgrub byed min/ /skyes bu'i ’sa pas skyon med pa'i/ /me sog rnam pa gzhan du mthong / /de ni ma byas par 'dod na/ /shes pa nyid kyi rgyur mi 'gyur/ /rtag pa dag la dngos nus pa/ /'ga' yang skye ba yod ma min/ rnam rtog bag chags las byung ba'i/ /sgro btags spyod yul can blo dag /'ga' zhig de las skye 'gyur gyi/ /don gyi spyod yul can ma yin/ /gal te byas dag log nyid du/ /mthong nyid phyir na ma byas pa'i/ /chig ni bden don can yin te/ /bzlog pas 'gal ba khyab gyir ro/ /med phyir gtan chigs ma bsnan na'ang / /de ni yod par dogs 'gyur te/ /dngos po 'gal ba dag la yang / khyab par byed pa mthong snyir ro/ /kun la med pa mi dmigs pas/ /mi 'grub ces ni bshad zin to/ /med pa nyid ni ma grub na/ /ldog pa nyid the tshom za/ /gal te rjes 'gro ldog pa dang / baspyob bya'i chos can la yod nyid/ /de des 'bras can shes pa yis/ /grub par gyur na sgrob byed yin/26/gang la bsgrub bya'i mi mthun phyogs//

bzlog pa nyid brjod de nyid ni/ /'di yi chos mthun 'gyur des na/ /gtan tshigs thams cad rjes 'gro can/ /'ga' yis brda byas nyid yin na/ /sngags rnams 'bras bu sgrub byed yin/ /ci ste dngos po'i nus yin na/ khyad par med snyir gzhan la'ang 'gyur/ /don gzhan nyid du gyur pa yi/ /bkod pa'ang sngar ni bsal ba yin//de don rtag tu 'grub 'gyur te/ /bstos pa yin na nus thed 'gyur/ /gal te dngos nus de 'dra na/ de ni kun gyi sgrub byed 'gyur/ /skegs byas min snyir byed pa po'i/ khyad par la yang stos mi rung / /dngos po 'dus byas pa yi yang / /dngos po'i tha dad tha dad byed/ /byed po'i khyad par las nus pa/ /nges pa ma yin bde las 'gyur/ khyad par byar med can yin na/ /ci zhig byed nas byed por 'gyur/ /gal te mngon gsal sbyor yin na/ /de ni gong du bsal zin to/ /gang las blo de gsal yin la/ de ni 'asdos bur gal te sbyor/ / ba po gsal rgyu yin pas/ nyan pa po yang 'bras 'brel 'gyur/ /mngon par gsal min spa dag gi byed pa rnams kyi sbyor ba 'am/ /yid gyi bzlas pa don med 'gyur/ /sgra ni rna ba'i spyod yul yin/ brgyud pas de las bskyed nyid phyir/ /blo de'ang gsal ba yin zhe na/ /gal te don can yin mi 'grub/ /rtog pa'i rīs su 'gro gyir ro/ rang dang snyi yi rang bzhin rnams/ /ngo bo gcig spya bsgrod 'dod nas/ /brda byed rnams kyis brjod pa'i phyir/ /mi 'gal dngos po la ma yin/ gal te go rim med na ni/ /ro dang mtsho zhes thos pa las/ /'bras tha dad med 'gyur zhe na/ /de ni skyes bu'i rten can yod/ /yi ge kun slong shes pa las/ /snyis la 27

shes las sgra skye'o/ /de yi khyad par can di ni/ /rna bas nges par 'gyur ba min/ /shes nges skyed pa'i shes pa can/ /de thos myur min thos pa can/ /de dran pa la bstos nas ni/ /gyis ni bdag nyid la dran byed/ de ni rgyu dang 'dzin mas kyi/ /yig rnams rgyu dang 'bras bu yi/ /go rim dag ni yin zhes brjod/ /de dag skyes bus byas pa nyid/ /de phyir mi ge'i ngo bo de/ / ga dang tshig las gzhan nyid de/ /byed po'i 'du byed las tha dad/ /lhan cig 'bras bus khyad par byed/ /yi ge rnams kyi go rim de'ang / /thel bar byed la 'jug yin te/ /'dod dang mi 'gal grub can gyi/ /go rim gnas pa 'gal phyir ro/ /skyes bu dang ni yi gi rnams/ /rgyu 'bras nyid du grub pa'i snyir/ /yi ge'i rim kun skyes bu las/ /me dang shing gi rigs pa bzhin/ /shes margya dag gis sngags zhes ba'i/ /go rim byed tshul can skyes bu/ /zun mong min pa nyid grub ste/ gzhan la de dag med snyir ro/ /gang yang rgyud rig 'ga' zhig gis/ /gsang jigs 'ga' zhig byed 'gyur ba/ /de dag gis de gtso bo'i mthu/ /de bshad rigs pa 'chug snyir ṭ+wāṃ// //'bras bu 'dod pas sngags rnams ni/ /byal dang skyes bus byas brjod skyes bu nus med sgrub byed ni/ /'di nyid kyis ni gsal ba min/ /blo dbang ba dang skyes bu nyid/ /la sogs spyob byed gang brjod pa/ /tshad ltar snang yin lhag ldan pas/ /gli bzhin don rtogal yod ma yin/ /sgra ni ngo bo 'di don dang / /'di don min zhes rjod mi byed/ /skyes bus don 'di brtags pa ste/ /de yang 'dod chags la sogs ldan/ /de gcig de nyid rig gzhan min//khyad par yang ni su mis byas/ /de bgin skyes nyid rnam 'gas kyang / khyed 28

ci shes ldan 'ga' mi 'dod/ /gal te gang 8ga tshad ma yis/ /mi slu de don rig yin na/ /shin tu skog tu gyur rnams la/ tshad ma yod pa srid ma yin/ gang gi tshig ni tshad ma yi/ /mi smyu de yis byas pa'i dzig de lung zhes thob de yi phyir/ skyes bus byas min don med yin/ /gal te shin tu skog gyur don/ /lung med par ni shes srid na/ /dbang po las 'das don rig 'ga'/ /yod do zhes ni mngon 'dod 'gyur/ bdag nyid 'dod chags sogs ldan pa'am/ /gzhan las rig byed don rig min/ /rig byed rig par byed min na/ /rig byed don ni gang las rtogs/ /des na mtho ris 'dod me la/ /sbyin zeg sbyin zhes thos pa las/ /khyi sha za zhes bya ba de/ /don min zhes 'di tshad ma gang / /'jig rten chig rab grags she na/ de la sna tshogs don can sgra'i/ /gang gi don 'di rnam dbye ba/ /dbang po las 'das don mthong gang / /grags min don brjod mtho ris gang / /lha mo la sogs sgra mthong ngo / /de 'dra'i sgra gzhan dag la ni/ /de 'dra'i rnam rtog nyid du 'gyur/ /grags pa dag kyang mi rnams tsheg /de yang tshad mar mi 'dod na/ /slar yang de las don rtogs pa/ /ldang 'dod 'di ni ci zhig yin/ /gal te grags pa las 'gal ba'i/ /rtog la rgyu ci yod ce na/ rab grags tshad ma nyid min snyir/ der 'dzin pa la rgyu ci yod/ /grags pa nyid kyi spa don gyi/ /nges la dogs pa bskyed pa ni/ /gang phyir de la sgra rnams don/ sna tshogs 'jug pa can nyid mthong / /nges byed ma mthong ba dag gis/ /sna tshogs nus can sgro rang nyid/ /nges par dogs pa 'gyur ba ste/ /gzhan du mi srid med snyir ro/ / 29

'ga' zhig lam ni 'di yin zhes/ sdong dum 'di ni smra 'gyur zhes/ /gzhan ni bdag nyid smra de ltar/ /de dag bye brag brtag par gyis/ /thams cad la rung don gcig gi /gsal byed nges pa gang las yin/ /brjod 'dod nges pa ma gtogs pa/ /gang gis dbang po las 'das shes/ /brjod 'dod nges pa'i rgyu yin zhing / /brda ni de yi gsal byed yin/ /de ni skyes min la med na/ de don gcig can de gang las/ /rang bzhin gyis ni nges yin na/gzhan la des kyang mi rung ngo / /bde yang don med can nyid 'gyur/ /brda las rang bzhin khyad par gyi/ /gsal ba'i nges pa gang las yin/ /gang la 'dod pa rang rgyud pa/ /de la nges pa zhes bya gang / /des na brda ni rung ba nyid/ /'dod pa kho na gsal mi 'gyur/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dag go /gang snyir rig byed phyogs gcig snyir/ /gzhan yang de 'dra yin te dper/ mes grang bzlog dag bden pa bzhin/ /de skad gzhan dag zer ro lo/ /ro 'dra ngo bo mtshungs nyid snyir/ /snad gcig la yang tshos pa bzhin/ /lhag ldan 'khrul pa can nyid snyir/ /rig pa shes pas 'di 'dra bkag /skyes bu rtag pa byed po nyid/ /dngos rnams rtag dang dbang po 'das/ /dbang pos gzung bya dang dngos rnams/ /rgyu dang gnas 'jig mi mnyam dang / /gzhan yang tshad ma rnams gnyis kyis/ /rnam par gsal ba'i spyod yul lam/ /lung la bltos pa rjes dpag dang / /'gal ba dag ni rjod byed pa/ /'gal ba kun hūṃ ma bsal zhing / /bstan bcos ston yang ma bstan la/ /de bden don bcas khas len pa/ /g.yem ma mu cor gyis rgyal lo/ gal te de ltar tshad grub na/ /'o na 'di la tshad min ci/ /skyes bu mang du smri ba la/ /bden pa'i don gcig med pa mi na/ /rjod pa po la sgra 30

gnas pas/ /'di dngos rang bzhin nam 'bras min/ /'di las rnam par bsgrog pas kyang / /'khyul pa med pa yod ma yin/ /rjod byed rnams kyis 'jug pa ni/ /brjod bya mthong bas byed ce na/ /phan tshun dag ni 'gal ba'i don/ /de ni gcig la ji ltar 'gyur/ /des na lung dang dngos po rnams/ /rtogs pa po yi rnam 'ga' yang / /med na mi 'byung mi 'grub na/ /de las don gang nges pa yin/ /de snyir de ni log na yang dngos po med par 'grub mi 'gyur/ /des na med nges 'bras bu can/ mi dmigs pas ni mi 'grub bo/ /rig byed tshad ma dang ni 'gal byed smra/ khrus las chos 'dod dang ni rig smras dregs/ /sdig pa gzhom snyir gdung ba rtsom zhes pa/ /thun po shes rab 'chal ba'i rtags lnga yin/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 8ga le'ur byas pa las rang don rjes su dpag pa ste le'u dang po'o/ /tshi tshad ma grub pa zhes bya ba'i ske'u/tshad ma bathu med can shes pa/ /don byed nus par gnas pa ni/ /mi thu sgra las byung ba yang / /mngon par 'dod pa ston snyir ro/ /smra ba po yi byed pa'i yul/ /don gang blo la rab gsal ba/ /de la sgra ni tshad ma nyid/ /don gyi de nyid rgyu can min/ /gzung ba 'dzin phyir kun rdzob ni/ mi 'dod blo ni tshad ma nyid/ /blang dang dor bya'i dngos po yi/ /'jug la de gatsho yin snyir dang / /yul rnam can ni tha dad pas/ /blo yi rtogs pa tha dad snyir/ /de yod na 'di yod phyir ro/ / 3/

rang las rang gi ngo bo rtogs/ /tha snyad las ni tshad ma nyid/ /bstan bcos rmongs pa zlog byed yin/ /ma shes don gyi gsal byed kyang / /rang gi ngo bo rtogs 'og tu/ /spyi yi rnam par shes pa thob/ /rang gi mtshan nyid mi k+tos/ pa// /shes pa gang yin zhes dgongs gyir/ /rang gi mtshan nyid dpyad snyir de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid/ /ma skyis pa ni bzlog don du/ /gyur pa nyid gsungs de yi snyir/ /sgrub byed la stos tshad yin rigs/ /tshad ma rtag pa nyid yod min/ /dngos yod rtogs pa tshad gyir dang / /shes bya mi rtag pa nyid kyis/ /de ni mi brtan nyid snyir ro/ /rim bzhin skye ba can dag ni/ /rtag las skye ba mi 'thad gyir/ /stos pa mi rung ba yi gyir/ rnam 'gas phan gdags bya min gyir/ /mi rtag na yang tshad med nyid/ /sdod 'jug dbyibs kyi khyad par dang / /don byed pa la sogs pa dag /'dod pa grub pa'am dpe ma grub/ /yang na the tshom za ba yin/ /byin rlabs yod med rjes 'jug can/ /dbyibs sogs ci 'dra rab grub pa/ /de las rjes su dpog gang yin/ /de ni rigs pa nyid yin no/ /tha dad dngos la rab grub pa/ /sgra mtshungs tha dad med pa'i snyir/ /rjes dpog rigs pa ma yin te/ /skye bo'i rdzas las me bzhin no/ /de lta min na rdza mkhan gyis/ /bum pa la sogs 'jim pa yi/ /rnam 'gyur 'ga' zhig byed pa'i phyir/ /grog mkhar yang des byas grub 'gyur/ /bsgrub bya'i rjes 'gro snyir 'bras bu /spyis kyang sgrub par byed pa la/ 'bril pa can nyid tha dad snyir/ tha dad skyon brjod 'bras mtshungs 'dod/ /rigs kyi khyad par la grub pa /sgra mi spyi ni mthong ba las/ /sgrub byed mi rigs ngag la sogs/ /go nyid phyir na rwa can bzhin/ /32

rjod par 'dod pa'i gzhan dbang phyir/ /sgra rnams gang la'ang med ma yin/ /de yod pas ni don grub na/ /thams cad kyis ni thams cad grub/ /'dis ni ser skya la sogs kyi/ /mi rtag sogs snyir yang sems med/ /sogs dang shun pa bshus na ni/ /'chi snyir sems ldan dpyad pa yin/ /dngos po'i ngo bo ma grub na/ /tshul 'di grub na ma grub kyang / khyad par gnod byed ma yin te/ /sgro yi nam mkha' la brten bzhin/ /sgra ma grub kyang dngos po ni/ /grub na grub par 'gyur te dper/ 'ug pa pa la sangs rgyas pas/ /lus sogs sgrub byed bshad pa bzhin/ /de nyid 'khrul la sogs yin na /spa ni 'khrul pa med na yang / /sgrub byed skyon ldan shes bya ste/ /dngos las dngos po grub snyir ro/ /'gro ba'i snyir dang lag ldan phyir/ /rwa can glang po zhes sgrub byed/ /'di yi sgra yi brjod bya ni/ /grags pa yin gyis brjod 'dod min/ /ji ltar dngos de rgyu yin pa/ de lta de nyid gang gi tshe/ /rgyu min gang gis de ni rgyur/ /'dod la rgyu ma yin mi 'dod/ /mtshon dang sman sogs 'brel pa las/ /nag pa'i rma dang 'drubs yin na/ /'brel med sdong dum ci yi snyir/ rgyu nyid du ni rtog mi byed/ rang bzhin khyad par med par ni/ /byed par yang ni mi tsung ngo / /rtag la ldog pa med pa'i phyir/ /nus pa nyid kyang rtogs par dka'/ /gang dag yod na gang 'gyur nyid/ /de dag las gzhan de yi rgyu/ /rtog pa yin na thams cad la/ /rgyu rnams thug pa med par 'gyur/ /myu gu skyed la sa la sogs/ /rang bzhin yongs su gyur nas ni/ /rgyu yin de legs byas pa na/de yi khyad par mthong snyir ro/ /gal te ji ltar yul dbang po/ /tshogs pa khyad med blo rgyu yin/ /de 33

ltar 'di yin zhe na min/ /de las khyad par yod gyir ro/ /so so so sor nus med rnams/ /rang bzhin khyad par med pas na/ /tshogs kyang nus pa med 'gyur bas/ /de snyir khyad par grub pa yin/ /de snyir so sor gang nus med/ /tshogs na yon tan srid 'gyur ba/ /de dag rgyu yin dbang phyug sogs/ /ma yin khyad par med phyir ro/ /tshad ma zhog gyur don shes yin/ /de spyob byed kyang med pa'i phyir/ /nan tan byed pa yod ma yin/ /zhes ni kha cig rab tu brjod/ /mi shes ston par byed pa la/ /'khrul par dogs pa can rnams kyis/ /des bshad nan tan bya ba'i gyir/ /shes ldan 'ga' zhig 'tshol bar byed/ /de phyir de yin bsgrub bya ru/ /'gyur ba'i ye shes rnam dpyad bya'i/ /'di yis srin bu'i grangs mkhyen pa/ /nged la 'gar yang nyer mkho med/ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni/ /thabs dang bcas pa rigs mdzad pa/ /gang de tshad ma nyid 'dod kyi/ /thams cad rigs mdzad ma yin no/ /ring po mthong ba'am min yang rung / /'dod pa'i de nyid mthong ba yin/ /gal te ring mthong tshad yin na/ /tshur skag bya rgod bsten par gyis/ /sgrub byerdu thugs rjes goms las de/ /blo ni lus la brten pa'i phyir/ /goms pas grub pa med ce na/ /ma yin rten ni bkag phyir ro/ /skye ba yongs su len pa na/ /'byung rngub dbang po blo dag ni/ /rang gi rigs la stos med can/ /lus nyid 'ba' zhig las skye min/ /ha cang thal phyir mtshams sbyor bar/ /nus ldan mthong ba gang de la/ /ci zhig yod 'gyur gang nad pa/ /gang gis phyi nas mtshams sbyor med/ /gang du drod gsher la sogs pa/ /skye pu skye bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /sa sogs cha de 'ga' yang med/ /de snyir thams cad sa bon bdag /de phyir 34

dbang sogs rang rigs la/ /stos pa med par 'byung yin na/ /ji ltar gcig ni yongs 'gyur bzhin/ /kun 'gyur khyad par med snyir ro/ /dbang rnams re re la gnod na/ /yid blo la gnod yod ma yin/ /'di 'gyur na ni de dag kyang / /'gyur ba dag tu mthong ba yin/ /de phyir blo gnas pa yi rten/ /blo nyid la ni brten pa 'ga'/ /dbang po rnams kyi rgyu yin pas/ /de snyir blo lag dbangatshopo yin/ de 'dra'i 'phen byed yod gyur na/ /snyis kyang de 'drar 'gyur ba yin/ /de yi shes pas phan 'doṭa phyir/ /yid ni lus la brten par bshad/ /gal ) dbang po med par blo/ /ma yin de yang de med par/ /de lta'ang phan tshun rgyu nyid pas/ /de snyir phan tshun rgyu can yin/ /rim can min las rim can min/ khyad par can min stos pa'ang med/ /lus las rim gyis blo 'gyur na/ /de'i yang rim pa gsal bar byed/ /skad cig snga ma snga ma ni/ /skod cig re re sngon med de'i/ rgyu yin de yi snyir na rgyu/ /thams cad tshe na mthong ba nyid/ /tha ma'i sems ni sems gzhan dang / /mtshams sbyor ba la 'gal ci yod/ /dgra bcom sems gang yin de yang / /gang las mtshams sbyor med par 'dod/tshad mas ma grub don can gyi/ /grub mtha'i rjes su 'brang ngam ci/ /gagyite de rgyu bral snyir na/ de nyid 'dir ni cis ma brjod/ /de blo bzhin du 'dzinaji'agyur gyir/ dbang po bcas las mid shes min/ /shes skyed nus pa tha dad snyir/ /kun las kyang ni ma yin no/ /sems med nyid phyir gzhan las min/ /rgyu gcig phyir na lhan cig gnas/ /dbang bzhin gzugs dang ro bzhin no/ /don gyi sgo nas 'gyur ba yin/ /35

rtaka tu de yi rjes 'jug phyir/ /gang zhig yod pas phan 'dogs byed/ /de rgyu de phyir bdun pa dang / /skyes snyir zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /'ga' zhig tshe na sems rgyun la/ /phan 'dogs byed pa'ang yin sla ste/ bum sogs la ni me sogs bzhin/ /de tsam gyis ni ldog pa min /lus ni gnas pa nyid na sems/ /ldog pa med par thal bar 'argyur/ /de yod yod dang dbang gyur phyir/ /de las 'byung rngub de ma yin/ /rlung 'byin pa dang 'dren pa ni/ /'bad rtsol med par gang las yin/ /de dag yul byung 'grib pa las/ /phul byung 'grib pa thob par 'gur/ /de dag la yang thal ba mtshungs/ sems rgyu yin na mtshungs ma yin/ /gnas pa'i 'phen byed gzhan dag kyang / /gang snyir rgyu ni yin par 'dod/ /gal te sdong bu la sogs bzhin/ /nyes pas mi mthun lus rgyu min/ /shi bas nyes pa nyams gyur tshe/ /smar yang 'tsho ba dag tu 'gyur/ /gal te me ni ldog na yang /shing gi 'gyur ba mi ldog bzhin/ /de ni sdog pa med ce na/ /ma yin gso sbyor yod snyir ro/ /blar mi 'byung bar 'ga' gig ni/ /la lar 'gyur ba skyed par byed/ /'ga' zhig ldog pa yin snyir dper/ /shing dang gser la me bzhin no/ /dang po chung yang ldog pa min/ /blar ldog rung bar 'gyur byas gang / /de ni slar yang 'byung 'gyur te /gser gyi za ba nyid bzhin no/ /cung da gso bya min brjodapa/ /'chos byed rnyed par dka' gyir ram/ tshe zad snyir ro nyes 'ba' zhig/yin na gso min med pa gnyis/ /shi ba'i dug sogs sdog snyir ram/ /de yi sos zin bcad las kyang / 'gyur ba'i rgyu dang bral bas na/ /de cis mar yang 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /nyer len 'gyur ba /ṭ+wāṃ par ni/ /nyer len can dag 'gyur

dīṭ+wāṃ /// //gyed par mi nus daspar 'jim pa/ /'gyur ba mid par bum sob/sa dngos gang 'gyur ba med par ni/ /dngos po gang zhig rnam 'gyur ba/ /de de'i nyer len mi rigs te/ /ba glang ba men la sogs bzhin/ /sems dang lus kyang de bzhin no/ /de rgyu lhan cig byed pa las/ /skye ba'i 'bras bu lhan cig gnas/ /me dang zangs ma'i zhu nyid bzhin/ /yod thed dag la rten med snyir/ /ma yin yod pa'i gnas rgyu ni/ /rten yin zhes na 'di rten med/ gnas pa po las gzhan min phyir/ /gzhan yin na yang de rgyu nyid/ /des ni dngos po ci zhig byas/ /'jigs pa med par thal bar 'gyur/ /gal te de 'jig rgyu las 'dod/ /de la'ang thal ba mtshungs pa yin/ /gnas pa'i rgyus kyang ci zhig byas/ /gal te 'jig rgyu zad bar du/ /des gnas 'jig pa dngos chos nyid/ /yod pa 'di gnod thed snyir dang / /gnas pa'i rgyus ni ci zhig bya/ /gal te dasprer na chu sogs kyi/ /rten bzhin zhe na 'di la'ang mtshungs/ dngos rnams skad cig re rer ni/ /'jig na dngos rgyun de lta bur/ /skye rgyu yin snyir de rten yin/ /de lha min na rigs ma yin/ 'bo ba yis ni gegs byed phyir/ /chu sogs kyi ni rten 'gyur gyi/ /'gro ba med can yon tan spyi/ /las rnams la ni rten ci dgos/ /'dis ni 'asbod pa 'du ba dang / /'phrod pa 'du ba can rgyu dang / rigs la sogs pa rnam gnas nyid/ /rten med phyir na gsal ba yin/ /gal te gzhan las dngos 'jig na/ /de yi gnas rgyus ci zhig bya/ /de gzhan med par 'jig na yang / /gnas pa'i rgyu rnams nus med yin/ /rten bcas thams cad gnas ldan dang / /rdi 7ba can kun rten bcas yin/ /de phyir

dngos po thams cad ni/ /'ga' zhig tshe na'ang 'jig mi 'gyur /gal te rang 'jig ngang tshul bdag /yin na de gnas byed gzhan gang / /gal te rang 'jig ngang tshul bdag min na de gnas byed gzhan gang / /lus kyi phul byung 'grib med par/ /blo yi byed pa'i khyad par gyis/ /shes rab la sogs phul byung dang 'grib pa dag tu 'argyur ba yin/ /'di ni mar ma'i 'od la sogs/ /rten pa rnams la yod ma yin/ /de las kyang 'di khyad 'gyur te/ /sems la phan 'dogs thed par min/ /'ga' tshe chags sogs rgyus sogs kyi/ /'phel ba bde rtsag las skyes yin/ /de yang khams stoms la sogs pa/ /nang gi don ni spre ba las/ /'dis ni 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /dran pa nyams sogs bshad pa yin/ /nang don khyad par las skyes pa'i/ /blos ni 'gyur bar byed snyir ro/ /dper rgyud khyad par 'ga' zhig la/ /stog nyid dang ni bag la sogs/ /thos pa dang ni mthong ba las/ rmongs pa la sogs 'byung 'gyur bzhin/ /de snyir nges par gang nyid kyi/ 'du byed kyis ni rjes 'jug pa'i/ /sems ni de med mi 'byung ba/ /de snyir sems la brten pa yin/ /ji ltar sems la brten byas nas/ /thos sogs 'du byed sems la ni/ /dus gsal tha dad med pa'i snyir/ /de ltar lus la yon tan 'gyur/ bdag la chags ba dang ldan pas/ /sems can gzhan gyis bkre min par/ /bde rtsag der thob 'dod pas na/ /dman pa'i gnas ni yongs su man/ /sdug bsngal snyin ci tsāg blo dang / /thed pa kun nas 'ching ba ni/ /skye rgyu gang la de med pa/ skyide ni skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te 'gro 'ong ma mthong na/ /dbang po mi gsal gyir ma mthong / /dper na mig mi gsal ba yis/ /du ba chung ngu mi mthong bzhin/ /38

lus can yin yang bra ba'i snyir/ /'ga' zhig la lar thogs med de/ /chu bzhin gser la dngul chu bzhin/ /ma mthong gyir na med pa min/ /lag sogs g.yo na thams cad dag /g.yo bar 'gyur snyir 'gal ba can/ /las ni gcig la mi rung gyir/ /gzhan du tha dad grub par 'argyur/ /gcig bsgribs pa na thams cad dag /bsgribs par 'gyur ba'am ma bsgribs na/ /mthong 'gyur gcig tshon gyis bsgyur na/ /babyur ba'am ma bsgyur rtogs par 'gyur/ /de snyir tshogs pa gcig yod min/ /du ma nyid na snga ma bzhin/ khyad thed snyir dang phra rab gyir/ /rtogs min zhe na khyad med pas/ /ma grub khyad par can rnams ni/ /dbang yul de snyir rdul phran min/ /'dis ni sgrib byed la sogs pa/ /med pa dag kyang bsal ba yin/ /dngul chu ga ra dang 'dres pa 'am/ /rdo tshon la sogs ji lhar nga / /dbang sogs so sor nus med rnams/ /rtogs pa dag ni ji ltar na/ /ldan las zhe na 'dir thal mtshungs/ gal te ga ra dang dngul chu ni/ ldan pas snang ba yin zhe na/ /rten mthong med par gang las rtogs/ /ro gzugs la sogs ldan par 'gal/ /gal te nye bar btags pa las/ /'dod na blo tha dad par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'phreng ring zhes byar 'argyur/ /de ldan rang gi ngo bo dang / /brjod pa dag las tha dad par/ /grangs ldan las la sogs pa yi ngo bo blo la mi snang ngo / /sgra shes dngos po tha dad pa'i/ /rjes 'brang rnam rtog brtags don can//dper na yon tan la sogs pa/ /zhig dang ma skyes dag la bzhin/ /gal te 'dir ni btags 'dod na/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis de 'dod pa/ /de ni dngos po thams cad la/ /de dag gi rgyus cis mi3 ḍidodaskyi

gal te kun la nyer btags min/ /tha dad khyid par gtso bo zhes/ /bya nyid gang las tha dad pa/ /med la tha dad don med na/ /don gzhan rgyu mtshan can min yang / /dkar la sogs pa grangs sogs dang / /ldan pa'i sgra ni rnam grangs min /gal te de la'ang don gzhan na/ /yon tan rdzas ni khyad med 'gyur/ /don gzhan min yang ldog pa mi/ /dbye bas tha dad pa yin te/ /las rdzas min pa'i sgra bzhin no/ /dngos po brjod pa'i sgra rnams kyis/ /grangs sogs de dang ldan pa las/ /tha dad bzhin du brton gang de'ang / /chos gzhan khyad par byed pa yin/ /de tsam shes par 'dod pa la/ /ga na kun 'phangs pa med par niskyi /la lar sor mo'i ldan pa zhes/ / dad chos bzhin rjod par byed/ /don gcig brjod kyang thams cad ni/ /'a na gyir sor mo ldan 'argyur zhes/ /chos can brjod par grags yin te/ de ltar brdar ni byas pa yin/ /gzugs sogs nus pa'i khyad par ni/ /sbong bas de mtshungs 'bras bu yi /rgyu min pa ni rnam gcod la/ /bum pa'i sgra ni 'jug par 'gyur /des na bum pa gzuṭa so zhes/ gzhi gcig pa can sgra ma yin/ /des na 'di ni rigs dang ni/ /tshogs pa brjod pa'i khyad par yin/ /de snyi yan lag spya byas te/ /bum pa yi ni gzugs sogs zhis/ /de nus khyad par ston par byed/ /phyogs 'dis gagin la'ang brjod par bya/ /ma lus rgyu nyid yin na ni/ /yan lag gcig dang bral na'ang min/ /re re nus pa nyid yin na'ang / /cig car mang po 'byung bar 'gyur/ /du ma nyid du mtshungs pa'i snyir/ /'byung rngub dag ni des byed min /gcig nyid na yang mang gsal 'argyur/ /de rgyu rtag tu nye snyir ro/ /gal te du ma'i rgyu min na/ /rim gyis kyang min khyad med phyir/ /0

dbugs gcig la yang don du ma/ /'dzin gyir de las nges ma yin/ /du ma blo gcig gis shes na/ /de ni cig car nyid 'gyur te/ /'gal ba med gyir rim gyis kyang / /mi 'gyur khyad par med phyir ro/ /rang rigs min pa'i dus can gyi /dbugs kyi skad cig mang po dag /gal te de 'dra'i sems nyid kyi/ /rgyu yin par ni rtogs byed na/ /go rim ldan pa'i rgyu med par/ /de dag rim ldan ji ltar 'gyur/ /rang rigs snga ma rgyu nyid na/ /dang po 'byung bar mi 'gyur te/ /di rgyu de 'dra yod ma yin/ /dbugs 'byung tha dad yul can snyir/ /yod kyang du ma nyid du nges/ /de snyir blo ni cig car skye/ /gal te du ma'ang gcig dus can/ / mas gcig gi ni rgyu yin na/ /dbugs rgyu zhan pa la sogs su/ /gcig ma tshang na'ang mi 'byung 'gyur/ ci lta ji ltar yod rgyu yin/ /shes pa la yang khyad yod 'gyur/ /gang zhig gang gi dad las/ /tha dad min de de 'bras min/ /rnam shes nus pa nges pa'i snyir/ /gcigani gcig gi rgyu yin te/ /rnam shes don gzhan chags pa yis/ /nus med don gzhan mi 'dzin snyir/ /gal te lus las cig car blo/ /skyes nga snyis ni rang rig las/ /nges na lus kyis nus pa ni/ /ci yi gyir na ldog pa yin/ /gal te lus ni ldog pa na/ /rten min phyir na sims 'ba' zhig /gnas 'gyur zhi na gal te di'i/ rgyu 'acag thob phyir mas kyi rgyun/ /gnas rgyu yan lag mi 'gyur na/ /tshe 'di nyid kyi skye mched lnga/ /lus gzhan skyed pa'i rgyu nyid yin/ /de yi yan lag dngos po dang / /rgyu nyid 'gog la mi dmigs pa/ /nges 'byed min par rab tu bshad/ dbang sogs kyang ni lhag ldan yin/ /dbang po snga ma rang rigs pas/ /nus pa dag ni mthong ba yin/ /'gyur ba mthong gyir gzhan dang 4

gzhan/ skye ba dag kyang 'grub pa nyid/ /gal te lus las de skye na /snga dzi bzhin du thal bar 'gyur/ / mas las zhi na lus gzhan yang / /'di nyid las ni skye bar 'gyur/ /des na rgyu dang bral ba'i snyir/ /tha ma yi ni sems rnams kun/ /mtshams sbyor med pa min de'i snyir/ /de 'dra'i sgrub byed lhag ldan 'dod/ /zhoms las khyad par 'gyur na mang / /mchongs dang chu yi drod bzhin du/ /rang bzhin las 'das min zhe na/ /byas te gal te blar yang / 'bad rtsol la ni stos 'argyur ram/ /rten mi brtan pa nyid 'gyur na/ khyad par dag ni mi 'phel na/ /rang bzhin di 'dra'ang ma yin te/ /de la phan 'dogs nus pa rnams/ khyad par snyi ma dag la ni/ / ba pa'i nus pa med snyir dang //rtag tu rten gnas ma yin snyir/ khyad par 'a la yang rang bzhin nyid/ /min gyir gang tshe byas gyur pa/ /yang rtsol la stos mi 'gyur na/ /rtsol gzhan khyad par byed par 'argyur/ /sems la brtse sogs goms skye ba/ /rang gi ngang gis 'jug 'gyur te/ /me la sogs pas skang dag dang / /dngul chu dang ni ga ra sogs bzhin/ /de snyir de dag las skyes te /ngo bo nyid skyes yon tan min/ /des na rtsol ba snyi ma dang / /snyi ma khyad par byed pa min/ /gang phyir rigs mthun lnga ma yi/ /sa bon las ni 'phel ba can/ /brtse ba la sogs blo de dag goms par rgyur na gang la gnas/ /de lhar mchongs nyid la mchongs min/ /de rgyu stobs dang 'bad rtsol dag nus pa nges pa nyid misnyir/ /mchongs pa nges pa'i bdag nyid yin/ /di ni dang po snyis nyid du/ /mchongs min lus mi mazun pa'i phyir/ /rtsol bas rim gyis mi margyan pa/ /bsal na rang stobs nyid du gnas/ /brtse rang sa bon las byung ba/ /gal te rang sa bon rgyu can/ mi 42

mthun phyogs kyis gnod med na/ /sems la de bdag nyid du 'gyur/ /'di ltar goms pa snga ma dang / /snga ma'i sems chos brtse ba dang / /chags bral blo sogs gzhan dag gi /gsal ba mi ni rtsa ba yin/ /goms las brtse ba'i bdag nyid de/ /chags bral chags dang da tsāg bgin/ /brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom pa'i gyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor ma5da/ /thabs byung de rgyu skog gyur ba/ /de 'a da pa dka' ba yin//lung dang rig pas rnam dablod pa/ /rgyag bsngal nyid kyi khyad par gyis/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang de mi rtag /la sogs rang ba na rtog par mdzad/ /gang snyir de ltar rgyu gnas na/ /'bras ldog gamigs pa med snyir ro/ /de rgyu gzhom gyir de yi ni/ /mi mazun phyogs la brtag pa mdzad/ /rgyu yi ngo bo rtogs pa'i snyir/ /de mi masgron phyogs kyang nges 'gyur/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin byas pa/ /'dus byas spyod yul can chags ni/ /rgyu yin de mi gnod byed ni/ bdag med mthong ba 'gal ba min/ /rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las de la skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /des na zugs kyang gsal ba'i gyir/ /rgyu yi bag chags spangs pa yin/ /thub chen gzhan don 'jug can gyi/ /bse tsu la sogs khyad 'di min/ de don snyir na thabs goms pa/ /de nyid ston pa min par 'dod/ grub la dang po 'byung ba'i snyir/ /gnyis po 'di ni rgyu ru bshad/ /rgyu spangs yon tan gsum bde gshegs/ /nyid yin sdug bsngal rten min gyir/ /legs yin de ni bdag med pa/ /mthong ba'am sbyor ba las yin no/ /skye dang skyon ni kun 'byung dag /slar yang ldog ces bshad pa min/ /bdag lta'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ /slar mi gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /de bden tha 43

dad bdag nyid kyis/ /lus ngag sims kyi gnas ngan sken/ /nyon mongs med dang nad med dang / /lam bshad mi gsal nyid lus yin/ /goms phyir ma lus spangs pa nyid/ /kha cig smra sogs snyir na skyon/ / da min zhes zer 'di sdog la/ /the tshom ba de gyir 'khyul/ /rtag nyid snyir ram thabs thed snyir/ /yang na thabs ni mi shes snyir/ /skyon rnams mi da pa nyid ces/ /bya bar yongs su rtog grang na/ /rgyu yod gyir dang rgyu mi ni/ /gaston po goms pas zad snyir dang / /rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa mis/ /de shes pa yang grub pa man/ /skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsungs pa/ 'bras med snyir na rdzun mi gsung / /rgyags brtse ldan gyir rtsom kun yang / /gzhan gyi don du sbyor snyir ro/ /de gyir tshad min yang na skyob/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston mdzad pa'o/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung po/ goms las 'dod chags sogs gsal ba/ /mthong snyir 'dod rgyal nyid min te/ /rgyu med skye ba 'gal snyir ro/ /'khrul gyir rlung sogs chos ma yin/ /gal te rang bzhin 'dres pa'i gyir /skyon da ce na de yi chos/ /de las gzhan yang cis ma mthong / /thams cad 'dod chags mtshungs par ni/ /thal gyir kun gyi chos ma yin/ /gzugs sogs bzhin skyon thed ce na/ /gal te de la khyad par can/ /las rnams bdag po ma yin na/ /der yang rtsod pa mtshungs pa min/ /chags sogs rang bzhin thams cad kyi/ /chos yin par yang 'dod na go /nus med rang bzhin med pas na/ /'bras bu mi mtshungs gang las yin/ /skyon rnams khyad par yod na yang / /khyad par mid snyir ma grub nyid/ /ma min thams cad 'gyur ba yis/ /'gyur snyir kun las skye ba'ang min/ /rgyu ni 'phel bar gyur pa na/ /'bras bu 'grub par mi rung ste/ /tsha ba sogs bzhin chag sogs kyi/ /'gyur ba bde sdug 44

las skyes yin/ /cha mi mnyam skyes sdug bsngal gyis/ /gal te 'dod chags mi skyed na/ cis skyed sbos skag cha mnyam las/ /khu 'phel de las 'dod chags yin/ /cha mi mnyam la chags can mthong / gzhan ni cha mnyam na yang min/ /gzhan ni zad nas sprug 'dzag kyang / /bud thed gcig la khu nges med/ de gcig la chags drag mi 'gyur/ /gal te gzugs sogs kyang yan lag /ma min kun ma nges snyir ro/ /nges pa med par 'byung ba'ang min/ /yon tan mi 'dzin pa la'ang 'gyur/ /gal te yon tan 'dzin de yang / /yan lag yin na ṭ+wāṃm/sa /cad kyis/ /yon tan 'dzin pa can 'argyur te/ /rgyu la khyad par med snyir gnas skabs gang la gas can 'dod/ /de 'dra zhe ldang can mi 'gyur//de gnyis ngo bo mi mtshungs snyir/ /'di la nges par mthong ba'ang med/ /gang gi 'dod chags la sogs pa/ /rigs mthun bag chags khyad par la/ /rag las pas ni 'jug 'gyur ba/ /di la skyon 'dir la ba med/ /'dis ni 'byung ba'i chos nyid bkag /rten yang bkag pa nyid snyir ro//dkar po la sogs sa sogs la/ /brten pa nyid ni ma yin sgo/ /de rten sgro yang rgyu don nam/ /yang na rang gi rten dag dang / /dbyer med par ni gnas pa'i snyir/ /rten yin gzhan du 'thad ma yin/ /gal te myos sogs nus pa bzhin/ /dbyer yod ce na dngos po las/ /nus pa don gzhan nyid ma yin/ /dajos po 'jig 'gyur rten chad par /gnas na rten pa 'jig pa yin/ /gal te de mtshungs zhe na min/ /snang ba tha dad can rtogs pas/ /'byung sems tha dad nyid snyir ro/ /ji srid lus ni 'gyur bar du/ /ga gas sogs bzhin du yid ngo bo/ 45/mtshungs 'gyur rnam par rtog pa ni/ /

don gyi gzhan dbang can nyid bhe/nga / /gang tshe lus la stos med par/ /shes pa 'ga' zhig 'ga' zhig girnga / /bag ji 3tsas sad pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba/ / des na 'ga' zhig las 'ga' yin/ rnam shes min pa rnam shes kyi /nyer len min pa'i gyir yang 'grub/ /gal te dngos po thams cad ni༈ /rnam shes nus ldan snyir 'dod na/ /rtsa sogs rtse na sprung chen brgya/ /rjon tshe ma mthong yod do zhes/ /de skad grangs can rgyugs las gzhan/ /ngo mtshar bcas pa su brjod rtsol/ /rgyu ni lan brgyar rnam phye yang / /ngo bo nga/nga zhig snang gyur pa'i/ /ngo bo de ni sngar mi snang / /ji ltar de ni yod par 'gyur/ /snga na med pa 'byung ba las/ /chags sogs nges med thal bar 'gyur/ /'byung ba'i bdag las ma 'das snyir/ /gal te kun chags sogs ldan na/ /thams cad 'dod chags mtshungs par 'gyur/ /gal te 'byung khyad las yin na/ /'byung rnams srog chags khyad med kyang / khyad par 'di rten gang yin pa/ /de ni phul byung 'grib pa bzhin/ /de yod pa las de med 'gyur/ /gal te chags sogs tha dad kyang / /rgyu mtshungs bdag nyid mi ldog snyir/ /min na bdag nyid 'dra rgyu'i snyir/ /kun la 'dod chags 'dra bar 'gyur/ /mtshungs bdag las byung ba glang gi /shes pa'am 'dir yang sa sogs la/ /srog chags nyid sogs khyad par gyi/ /rim pa la lar yod ma yin/ /dro rim khyad par yod na yang / /dro med me 'ga' yod min pa/ /di bzhin 'dir yang zhe na min/ /dro las me gzhan bkag gyir ro/ /gang zhig gzhan yod yon tan ni/ khyad par rim pa dang ldan pa/ /de dag de yi khyad par ni/ /la lar 'chaṭ+wāṃ6 'gyur dkar sogs bzhin/ /gzugs

sogs bzhin du nges min te/ de dag 'byung dang dbyer med snyir/ /gal te de mtshungs she na min/ chags sogs lhan cig skyes thal snyir/ /rnam par brtags pa yul yin snyir/ /yul yang nges byed ma yin no/ skal mnyam rgyu dang bral ba'i phyir/ /chags sogs nges pa med pa'am/ rgyu ni nye snyir blo rnams kun/ /thams cad kun tshe skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni res 'ga' dmigs pa'i snyir/ /mi rtag nyes pa'i rten snyir dang / /rgyu dbang snyir yang sdug bsngal yin/ /bdag min byin gyis brlabs pa'ang min/ /rgyu min byin gyis rlob pa min/ /rtage pa ji ltar snyid byed na/ /de snyir gcig las du ma ni/ /dus dad par skye mi 'gyur/ /rgyu gzhan dag ni tshogs na yang /'bras bu skye ba med pa'i snyir/ /rgyu gzhan rjes su dpog 'gyur na/ /de ni rtag rnams la yod min/ /res 'ga' ba nyid yin pas na/ /thug bsngal nyid rgyu bcas nyid grub//rgyu med gzhan la mi stos snyir/ /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur/ /ji ltar tsher ma la sogs kyi/ /rna ba nyid sogs rgyu med pa/ /de ltar 'di dag rgyu med 'gyur/ /zhes ni kha cig rab tu brjod/ /gang yod nyid na'ang gang skye ba'am/ /gang 'gyur na yang rnam 'argyur ba/ /de ni de rgyu rab tu brjod/ /de ni de rnams 'a yang yod/ /reg pa gzugs rgyu nyid yin gyir/ mthong ba la ni rgyu mtshan yin /rtag rnams bkag cing dbang myug la /sogs pa las kyang srid min te/ /nus med snyir ro de yi snyir/ /srid 'dod rgyu yin gang gi phyir/ /mi rnams yul gyi khyad par ni/ /yongs 'dzin de thob bsam pas byas/ /de ni srid 'dod gang snyir yang / /sprog chags bde sdug thob pa dang / /'dor 'dod 'jug pa de dag ni /ṭ+wāṃ/da dang 'jig sred yin par 'dod/

bdag tu chags pa'i rgyu nyid lasaskyi /bde min bde bar 'du shes pas/ /kun la rab tu 'jug 'gyur ba/ /de phyir sped pa srid rten yin/ /chags bral skye ba ma mthong snyir/ /zhes ni slob dpon rnams kyis gsungs/ /lus med chags pa ma mthong phyir/ /lus las kyang ni 'dod chags 'byung / /rgyu mtshan khas blangs snyir na 'dod/ /nyer len nyid ni bsal ba yin/ /rigs 'di rjes su 'dod na ni/ /rang nyid rang 'dod la gnod 'gyur//gal te skye la chags mthong phyir/ /skye dang lhan cig 'byung zhe na/ /skal mnyam skye phyir sngar grub yin/ /mi shes srid pa'i rgyu yin yang / ma brjod zid pa nyid bshad pa/ /rgyun ni 'phen pa byed snyir dang / /di ma thag gyir las kyang min/ /de yod na yod thed gyir ro/ /de ni gtan du ba yin te/ /rgyu la gigs sogs srid snyir ro/ /'khor phyir thar pa med ce na/ /ma yin 'dod dang ma grub snyir/ /ji srid bdag chags ma bcom zhing / /de ni yongs su gdung 'gyur ba/ /de srid sdug bsngal sgro btags nas/ /rang bzhin du ni gnas pa med/ /grol ba po ni mid na yang / /log par sgro 'dogs gzhom gyir brtson/ /'dod chags bral ba'i gnas pa ni/ /brtse ba'am yang na las kyis yin//'phangs las sdog da 'dod snyir ro/ /srid pa'i gred las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/ /lhan cig byed pa zad snyir ro/ /sdug bsngal shes la 'gal thed pas/ /'du byed snga ma 'jug pa can/ /dngos chos brtse ba skye ba de/ /sems can rjes 'brel can ma yin/ /de bdag min pa'i chos la ni/ /bdag gzhan sgro 'dogs pa las chags/ /sdug bajil rgyun rig tsam las ni/ /brtse ba skye ba/8 'argyur ba yica / /

ga) mug nyes pa'i rtsa ba ste/ /de yang soms can 'ardzon pa min/ de med nyes rgyu las kho min/ /des na brtse ba nyes med 'dod/ /grol med ma yin mngon 'du byed/ /zad nas gzhan mtshams mi sbyor snyir/ /'du byed nus pa ma zad na/ /gang de gnas pa nyes med nyid/ /snying rje dman pa nyid snyir yang / /gnas pa'i 'bad rtsol chen po med/ /gang dag brtse ba chen po pa/ gzhan gyi ngor ni bzhugs pa yin/ /gal te 'jig tshogs rto bral snyir/ /lam dang por ni srid med 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes pa ma spangs gyir/ /spangs na'ang srid pa ga la yod/ /bde bar gyur pa'am thug bajil bar/ /ma gyur cig ces 'dod pa na/ /nga 'o snam pa'i blo gang de// mas can la blta lhan cig skyes/ /nga zhes mthong ba med par ni/ /'ga' yang bdag la chags ma yin/ /bdag la sred pa med par yang / /bde ba 'dod pas mngon rgyug min/ /sdug bsngal skye ba'i rgyu nyid ni/ /'ching yin rtag la de gang las/ /thug bsngal mi skye rgyu nyid / /thar yin rtag la de gang las/ /mi rtag nyid du brjod med gang / /di ni 'ga' yi'ang rgyu ma yin /brjod bya min la'ang bcings dang thar/ /ji lta bur yang yod ma yin/ /gang gi rang bzhin 'jig med pa/ /de la mkhas rnams rtag ces brjod/ /des na ngo tsha'i lta ba 'di/ thongs la de ni rtag par rjos/ /bshad zin lam de goms pa laspe/ /gnas gyur gal te gnas rgyur kyang / /lam bzhin skyon ni 'byung zhe na/ /ma yin nus pa med sbyir ro/ /rnam shes yul 'dzin pa yi skyos/ /ji ltar yod de 'dzin pa ngang /yod pa yi ni bdag nyid de/ /'di yis skyed par byed pa'ang min/ /rang bzhin 'di yin 'di las de/ /rkyen gzhan gyis ni gol 'gyur zhing / /ldog pa 49

la ni rkyen la stos/ /mi brtan sbrul gyi blo bzhin no/ /sems rkye rang bzhin 'od gsal te /dri ma rnams spro bur ba/ /de snyir sngar yang nus med rnams/ /de bdag rgyur la snyis nus med/ /nus yod na yang gnod pa can/ /skyed nus sgyung po can dngos la/ /byun du gnas nus yod min te/ /sa rlon la ni me bzhin no/ /'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /rang bgin la ni snyin log gis /'bad du zin kyang mi zlog ste/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /bdag 'dzin rgyu gcig can nyid dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po'i gyir/ /'dod chags khong khro phan tshun du/ /tha dad na yang gnod ma yin/ byams sogs smongs dang 'gal med gyir/ /shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min/ /nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can/ /de yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin/ /rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs snyir dang / /sems byung nyid kyis dmigs pa'i gyir/ /log par dmigs nyid ma rig par/ /gsungs snyir gzhan ni rigs ma yin/ /'gal ba gang yin 'dir bshad bya/ /stong nyid lta dang de 'gal gyir/ /de yi rang bzhin nyes kun dang / /'gal bar rab tu grub pa yin/ /zad min srog chags chos ’da snyir gzugs sogs bzhin min ma grub phyir/ /gnyen po'i phyogs dang 'brel ba na/ /sdog pa dag kyang mthong snyir ro//nyes pa rnam par 'gags pa ni/ /za zhing slar yang skye med de/ /de bdag nyid kyis 'bral med dang / /thal ba bzhin du ma nges snyir/ /gang zhig bdag mthong de la ni/ /nga zhis rtag spya zhen par 'gyur/ /zhen pas bde la sred 'gyur te /sred pas skyon rnams sgrib par byed/ /yon tan mthong bas yongs sred pa/ /nga mi zhis de'i sgrub byed len/ /des na bdag la mngon chags pa/ /de grid de ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /50
